achievements/armed_desc: Complete the Arms Dealer Special Ops mission.
achievements/ashes_desc: Burn 4 enemies with a single molotov.
achievements/cinderblock_desc: Only use one cinder block and bring it to the end of 'Embedded'.
achievements/dodgebullet_desc: Never get hit by the sniper while escaping captivity.
achievements/driversed_desc: Shoot the driver of the suicide truck.
achievements/finish_desc: Finish single player on any difficulty.

achievements/hangtime_desc: Kill 3 enemies while you are on a ladder.
achievements/hotswap_desc: Get at least one kill with eight different weapons when completing 'Old Comrades'.

achievements/laundered_desc: Complete the Money Launderer Special Ops mission.
achievements/lightsout_desc: Shut off the power to 4 buildings in 'Going Dark'.
achievements/lovefromabove_desc: Destroy 4 trucks with 4 drone strikes before they reach the end of their path in 'The Embassy'.
achievements/nofriendlyfire_desc: Do not injure any civilians in 'Piccadilly'.
achievements/ownthenight_desc: Kill all enemies at the Church, Clocktower, and Pool without anyone calling for backup.
achievements/pilotkill_desc: Crash a helicopter by shooting the pilot.
achievements/pitstop_desc: Stop three APCs with Hadir's sniper rifle.
achievements/playdead_desc: Kill all the enemies in the 'Embedded' field of dead bodies.
achievements/smokedirect_desc: Kill an enemy with a direct hit from a smoke grenade.

achievements/smuggled_desc: Complete the Smuggler Special Ops mission.
achievements/tunnelrat_desc: Complete 'The Wolf's Den' tunnels using only the 1911.
achievements/twobirds_desc: Kill both soldiers with one shot in 'Hometown'.
achievements/vetfinish_desc: Complete every single player mission on Veteran or Realism difficulty.
achievements/waronfore_desc: Reach Barkov's lab entrance using only drone strikes.
achievements/wildfire_desc: Take down a flying helicopter with a molotov.

cinematics/captive_desc: With the Wolf dead, but Hadir and the gas still at large, Farah’s forces are put on the Foreign Terrorist Organization list. Alex chooses to stay with Farah’s army.
cinematics/embassy_desc: Following capture of The Wolf, Alex, Farah and Hadir prepare to hand him off to Price & Kyle. Militants led by the Butcher storm the embassy to free the Al-Qatala leader.
cinematics/epilogue_desc: In the wake of their success against Barkov, Price and Laswell discuss the formation of new task force called “141.”
cinematics/estate_desc: On the heels of a trying interrogation of the Butcher, Price and Kyle race to intercept Hadir at Barkov’s estate as Kyle questions where they draw the line.
cinematics/highway_desc: Farah hatches a plan to ambush the Wolf on the “Highway of Death” before he can escape to the mountains.
cinematics/lab_desc: Hadir discovers the location of Barkov’s gas factory but is apprehended by Price and Kyle. Laswell gives Hadir to the Russians. Price asks Farah to help him destroy the lab.
cinematics/marines_desc: Alex and Farah prep for a mission to capture the Wolf. Farah explains that anyone who uses terrorist tactics is her enemy, without exception.
cinematics/piccadilly_desc: After terrorists steal Russian gas from General Barkov’s PMCs, Laswell calls Captain John Price for help with recovering the stolen chemicals and de-escalating tensions with Russia.
cinematics/proxywar_desc: CIA Station Chief Kate Laswell commands an operation with Ground Branch officer Alex and Marine Raiders to intercept a chemical weapons shipment bound for Urzikstan.
cinematics/sacrifice_desc: The team plants charges to demolish Barkov’s gas facility but the detonator is damaged. Alex volunteers to sacrifice himself and set off the explosions manually.
cinematics/safehouse_desc: When Al-Qatala claims responsibility for a London attack, SAS Sgt. Kyle Garrick wants to escalate. Alex meets with militia Commander Karim to join forces in pursuit of the stolen gas.
cinematics/safehousefinale_desc: From Hadir’s safehouse, Hadir and Alex prep for an assault on General Barkov’s airbase.
cinematics/stpetersburg_desc: Then: Lt. Price helps rescue Farah and Hadir from Barkov’s POW camp. Now: intel says Hadir is planning an attack in Russia. Price and Laswell launch a covert mission to stop it.
cinematics/townhoused_desc: Kyle’s intel leads to a raid on a London townhouse where the Al-Qatala terror cell is holed-up.
cinematics/tunnels_desc: Upon discovering that her brother Hadir is responsible for stealing the Russian gas, and is now in Al-Qatala’s hands, Farah vows to hunt him down alongside Price’s team.

codcaster/move_right_desc: Hold to ^5Move Right^7 while using the Free Camera or the Aerial Camera.

codcaster/player_order_desc: Manage the player order which will be used when CODcasting.
codcaster/qs_listen_in_hint: Listen in to the team of the spectated player.
codcaster/qs_player_card_hint:
Display or hide the ^5Player Card^7.

This widget displays the player name, operator, team logo, equipped weapon and ammo.
codcaster/qs_player_hud_hint: Display the in-game player HUD as configured in Settings.
codcaster/qs_player_list_hint:
Display either the ^5Portrait List^7 or the ^5Player List^7 in the ^5Team List^7.

The ^5Portrait List^7 displays operator portraits.
The ^5Player List^7 displays brief player stats.
codcaster/qs_playernameplates_desc: Display or hide ^5Player Names^7 over in-game operators.
codcaster/qs_score_panel_hint: Display or hide the ^5Score Header^7 which hosts team scores, game and objective clocks, and the information panel.
codcaster/qs_screen_border_hint: Briefly display a team colored border around the screen when switching players.
codcaster/qs_team_list_desc:
Display or hide the ^5Team List^7.

When Enabled, this widget displays the ^5Portrait List^7 or the ^5Player List^7.
The displayed list can be set using the ^5Team List Type^7 option.
codcaster/qs_xray_desc: Toggle XRAY for players and objectives. XRAY type can be changed in the Display Settings sub-category.
codcaster/qs_xray_hint:
Display or hide ^5XRAY^7 outlines for players and objectives.

XRAY Type can be changed using the ^5XRAY Type^7 setting below.
codcaster/quick_settings_desc: Control which Quick Settings are enabled by default when CODcasting.
codcaster/reorder_lobby_tool_tip: Automatically reorder lobby from order specified in broadcast files
codcaster/slow_down_desc:
Hold to use a ^5slower movement speed^7 in Free Camera.
Release to return to normal Free Camera movement speed.
codcaster/speed_up_desc:
Hold to use a ^5faster movement speed^7 in Free Camera.
Release to return to normal Free Camera movement speed.
codcaster/starting_camera_desc: Choose whether the match starts using the ^5Default Camera^7, the ^5Free Camera^7 or the ^5Aerial Camera^7.
codcaster/swap_teams_desc: Swap the name, icon and color of both teams.
codcaster/team1_settings_desc: Modify the name, icon and color for Team 1.
codcaster/team2_settings_desc: Modify the name, icon and color for Team 2.
codcaster/team_identity_desc: Choose default ^5Factions^7 team identities or use ^5Custom^7 team logos, names and colors.
codcaster/team_settings_tips_desc:
- Team names allow up to 30 characters in length.

- Primary colors are the main colors used to identify teams on various CoDCaster elements. This includes the Portrait List, Player Card, Score Header, XRAYS, Announcements, Minimap arrows and more.

- Secondary colors are used on detailing elements including Player Names the Team List and the Player Card, on Announcements and Objective Waypoints letters.

- Pick primary and secondary colors that have good contrast between them.

- Avoid color combinations that are unfriendly for colorblind viewers such as using red and green.
codcaster/ticker_space_desc:
Offset the ^5bottom CoDCaster elements^7 toward the top of the screen.

This allows CoDCasters to display their own overlays at the bottom of the screen without the need to hide CoDCaster elements.

cp_intel/aar_assessment_aniyah_allies: Allegiance forces engaged indigenous fighters and western assets in contest for the Urzikstani Presidential Palace, indicating a power play in the region. Orders to disengage resulted in successful Allegiance capture of the palace, denying victory to the people of Urzikstan.
cp_intel/aar_assessment_aniyah_axis: During their successful raid and capture of the Urzikstani Presidential Palace, Allegiance forces encountered a combined force of Coalition soldiers and indigenous fighters confirmed to be Al-Qatala. Both forces appeared to be fighting in unison, suggesting that a splinter faction of the Coalition may be operating in conjunction with Al-Qatala. Evidence should be presented to Allegiance command at once.
cp_intel/aar_assessment_caves_allies: Lighthouse 2 reacted with appropriate force when engaged by a hostile Allegiance element. Allegiance objective at Alzilu Alsayf unclear. Anti-aircraft guns used to engage Coalition UAV presumed to be Al-Qatala operated, but Allegiance may have been responsible. Their attempt to recover aforementioned blackbox, and their willingness to use engage Lighthouse 2, recommends this possibility.
cp_intel/aar_assessment_caves_axis: Kurgan 1 acted in appropriate defense from a hostile Coalition force, resulting in casualties on both sides. Rules of engagement observed. Status of Coalition asset (UAV) unknown, presumed recovered by Coalition. Al-Qatala presence successfully eliminated- AQ reoccupation of Alzilu Alsayf probable without Allegiance occupation.
cp_intel/aar_assessment_runner_allies: Arrowhead 3 identified a known ultranationalist associate in direct communication with Allegiance personnel on the ground. ROEs were properly observed, returning fire as a last resort. Level of Allegiance resistance supports possibility of collaboration between Sokolov, Mr. Z, and Allegiance forces, though a splinter Allegiance group may be responsible.
cp_intel/aar_assessment_runner_axis: All efforts made to avoid direct conflict with Coalition forces, mitigating risk of open hostilities. Coalition presence in this territory could indicate increased hostility toward Allegiance-protected territories. However, first shots fired from Sokolov Facility were not fired by Omega 1 or any Allegiance force. Recommend forced occupation of the Sokolov Facility and increased Allegiance presence in the region.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_1_aniyah_all: Warrior 1 surrounds target perimeter. Reaver 2 sweeps the exterior grounds, dropping 3 AQ patrols. No alarms raised.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_1_aniyah_axi: Blacksmith 4 returns fire to cover active infiltration. Squads fast-rope into the palace grounds, take position, and engage the enemy.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_1_caves_alli: Allegiance force opens small arms fire, wounding Lighthouse 2-0 in command. Lighthouse 2 returns fire, secures 2-0, and secures crashsite.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_1_caves_axis: Kurgan 1 arrives on station, begins house-to-house sweep- 14 AQ combatants killed. Progressed into caves, clearing small security force- 8 AQ combatants. No casualties reported.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_1_runner_all: Identifies Allegiance forces on the ground in the facility- in verbal contact with owner/proprietor Leonid Sokolov- known associate of arms dealer "Mr. Z". Governor 1 relays orders to hold position and report changes.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_1_runner_axi: Omega 1 forces entry through the main gate and begin sweep of Sokolov Facility and surrounding area. Omega 1-1 in command questions Sokolov.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_2_aniyah_all: Reaver 2 moves interior, Warrior 1 occupies grounds. Reaver 2 goes loud, executes room to room sweep. North, south, and west palace wings clear.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_2_aniyah_axi: Blacksmith 4 kills 12/18 identified AQ targets. Additional enemy forces exit the palace and engage.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_2_caves_alli: Heavy fire sustained from occupying Allegiance force. Orders received to press enemy back into the caves, providing cover for blackbox recovery and emergency egress.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_2_caves_axis: AQ A-A fire observed from western horizon. RU-00 reports Coalition UAV on approach for emergency landing.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_2_runner_all: Unmarked convoy arrives at the main gate, prompting an apparent argument between Sokolov and Allegiance personnel.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_2_runner_axi: Unmarked convoy arrives at the gate, Omega 1-1 reports to RU 03 and gives order to search the trucks. Sokolov protests.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_3_aniyah_all: Warrior 1 engages unknown targets outside the palace grounds. Reaver 2 clears east wing of remaining AQ, then moves exterior to support.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_3_aniyah_axi: Blacksmith 4-1 in command receives unconfirmed reports of Coalition forces among the AQ fighters. RU 03 gives full authority to engage.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_3_caves_alli: Allegiance forces pressed into retreat, egressing to emergency LZ for B-Lima extraction.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_3_caves_axis: UAV crash landing- center of target village. RU-00 reports Coalition recovery force on approach- gives order to egress and extract.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_3_runner_all: Arrowhead 3 begins taking sniper fire from several vectors within the facility.  Governor 1 denies the request to engage, orders Arrowhead 3 to egress to secondary LZ.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_3_runner_axi: Shots fired from windows within the facility. Omega 1-1 orders defensive posture. Targets are identified in the southern forest. RU 03 gives order to intercept and detain.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_4_aniyah_all: Reaver 2 confirms Allegiance contact. Reaver 2 and Warrior 1 set perimeter and hold defense. Warrior 1 sustains heavy casualties.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_4_aniyah_axi: Enemy forces routed- full retreat. Blacksmith 4 moves in to clear and secure the palace compound, ordering Blacksmith 4-5 and 4-6 to maintain fire on retreating force.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_4_caves_alli: All Coalition wounded accounted for and prepped for CASEVAC; 4 Allegiance KIA. Blackbox recovered from aircraft prior to thermite demolition. Lighthouse 2 execute sweep of caves, discovering multiple caches of Al-Qatala weaponry. Timed charges set prior to egress/exfil.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_4_caves_axis: Coalition force arrives. Attempts to contact met with small arms fire. Kurgan takes firing positions in buildings and caves; returns fire. 5 Coalition units down, Kurgan 1, 2 units.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_4_runner_all: Allegiance forces cut off Arrowhead 3 retreat, forcing engagement inside the facility. Visual lost on Sokolov.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_4_runner_axi: Sokolov retreats. Coalition forces arrive in the facility, engaging Omega 1. RU 03 gives command to return fire and cover retreat.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_5_aniyah_all: Governor 1 gives order to cut bait and egress to designated LZ. Reaver 2-1 requests to hold position- denied.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_5_aniyah_axi: Blacksmith 4 confirms Coalition units and Al-Qatala fighters among the dead.
cp_intel/aar_engagementtext_5_runner_all: Taking casualties, Allegiance forces retreat through the main gate. Arrowhead 3 secures the facility. Identifies shipment as chem-bio, coupled with missile stockpiles in the railhouse. Chem-bio tagged for EOD recovery, thermite set for missile demolition.
cp_intel/aar_exfiltext_aniyah_allies: Reaver 2 egress under fire to designated LZ in city ruins northeast of the palace. Remaining Warrior 1 forces scatter into the surrounding area.
cp_intel/aar_exfiltext_aniyah_axis: Occupation force Horseman 2 arrives to assume control of the palace. Blacksmith 4 moves to exfil from the main courtyard.
cp_intel/aar_exfiltext_caves_allies: Lighthouse 2 egress to rendezvous with truck convoy.
cp_intel/aar_exfiltext_caves_axis: B-Lima exfil arrives on station. Kurgan 1 moves to egress under fire- minimal injuries sustained.
cp_intel/aar_exfiltext_runner_allies: Arrowhead 3 egress to rendezvous at secondary LZ for extraction.
cp_intel/aar_exfiltext_runner_axis: Omega 1 egress under fire to light vehicle convoy and proceed en route to Yaschuk Farm.
cp_intel/aar_extracttext_aniyah_axis: Blacksmith 4 arrives at Outpost Forerunner for debrief.
cp_intel/aar_extracttext_caves_allies: Lighthouse 2 proceed southbound on Tariq Almawt to Coalition safehouse/airfield, Alfidiya.
cp_intel/aar_extracttext_caves_axis: Extraction to Riddam successful. All casualties recovered.
cp_intel/aar_extracttext_runner_axis: Omega 1 arrive at Yaschuk Farm. 3 wounded, prepped for evacuation.
cp_intel/aar_infiltext_aniyah_allies: Reaver 2 and Warrior 1 arrive at LZ bravo, 1 klick from target. Proceed on foot to palace perimeter.
cp_intel/aar_infiltext_aniyah_axis: Blacksmith 4 arrive on target, immediately engaged by AQ targets on the palace grounds.
cp_intel/aar_infiltext_caves_allies: Lighthouse 2 arrives on station, identifies Allegiance force holding on crashsite, working to extract onboard storage. Demon Dogs TL gives order to "confront" Allegiance, not engage.
cp_intel/aar_infiltext_caves_axis: Aerial infil B-Lima departs Riddam, bound for Alzilu Alsayf. Surveillance reports minimal activity in village.
cp_intel/aar_infiltext_runner_allies: Arrowhead arrives on station, south of the target area.
cp_intel/aar_infiltext_runner_axis: Omega 1 convoy arrives at Sokolov Facility. Greeted at the gate by Leonid Sokolov but denied entry.
cp_intel/aar_insertext_aniyah_allies: Reaver 2 and Warrior 1 rendezvous at Coalition Airfield Hotel-51, 10 klicks from target. Dust off in light helo squad Nomad 2.
cp_intel/aar_insertext_aniyah_axis: Blacksmith 4 rally at Outpost Forerunner. Board B-Lima helos for transport to target, 5 km distance.
cp_intel/aar_insertext_caves_allies: Lighthouse 2 convoy travelling westbound on 'Tariq Almawta'1 km from target, rerouted for emergency retrieval.
cp_intel/aar_insertext_caves_axis: Kurgan 1 rallies at abandoned village of Riddam, 3 km northeast of target.
cp_intel/aar_insertext_runner_allies: Arrowhead 3 rendezvous at Arklov Peak Military Base in northern Verdansk. Board light helicopter group Leatherback 1 for aerial infil.
cp_intel/aar_insertext_runner_axis: Omega 1 rally for patrol at Yaschuk Farm, northeast of Verdansk. Boarded light vehicle convoy for patrol.
cp_intel/aar_mission_aniyah_allies: Coalition strike force (callsign Reaver 2,) LF force (callsign Warrior 1,) Governor 1 overwatch. Former Presidential Palace of Urzikstan occupied by Al-Qatala, taken from rogue Gen. Roman Barkov. Reaver 2 tasked with securing the palace grounds and interior for handoff to LF control. Allegiance forces arrived, engaged Reaver 2 and LF forces on the ground.
cp_intel/aar_mission_aniyah_axis: Allegiance operation force, callsign Blacksmith 4, RU 03 in command. Unrest in the region caused by the criminal Roman Barkov allowed Al-Qatala to occupy the former Presidential Palace of Urzikstan. Blacksmith 4 ordered to infiltrate, clear, and secure the palace for Allegiance control. Encountered and repelled both Al-Qatala and Coalition forces on the ground.
cp_intel/aar_mission_caves_allies: Coalition QRF, callsign Lighthouse 2, Demon Dogs TL overwatch. Coalition UAV reported shot down by Al-Qatala forces based in Alzilu Alsayf village, Urzikstan. QRF dispatched to clear village of AQ fighters, secure the crashsite, recover UAV blackbox, and demo the aircraft. Allegiance QRF spotted on approach, restricting ROEs to defensive posture.
cp_intel/aar_mission_caves_axis: 10 Allegiance Special Infantry (Callsign "Kurgan") with RU-00 overwatch. Infiltrate, secure, and capture known Al-Qatala stronghold and cave complex- Alzilu Alsayf village, Urzikstan. Surveillance indicated frequent shipments moving through caves, supplying AQ insurgents in the central and southeast region. Primary objective to sever flow of weapons/materiel and gather intel to identify supply routes and sources.
cp_intel/aar_mission_runner_allies: Coalition recon force, callsign Arrowhead 3, Governor 1 overwatch. Intel identified the Sokolov Mining and Lumber facility (northern Kastovia mountains) as a potential chem-bio storage facility tied to rogue Gen. Roman Barkov. Arrowhead 3 tasked with surveillance; dispatched to infil the surrounding forest and recon the facility. Allegiance force identified on site, restricting ROEs to defensive posture.
cp_intel/aar_mission_runner_axis: Allegiance patrol, callsign Omega 1, RU 03 overwatch. Reports indicated unidentified convoys traveling rural backroads around Verdansk. Omega 1 received orders to make contact with Leonid Sokolov of the Sokolov Mining and Lumber facility- known smuggler and top of the list for questioning. Unidentified snipers were spotted in the surrounding forest, prompting swift action by Omega 1.
cp_intel/billet_alias_krueger: The Austrian, Cpl. Josef Doss (fmr. KSK 4th Platoon)
cp_intel/billet_alias_yegor: Valentyn Zavarov, Anton Husin, Vitalij Nesmachniy, Valerij Pyatov, Yaroslav Rusol
cp_intel/billet_associations_alice: -Helped coordinate unsanctioned mission with Sgt. Wayne Davis- “DDay,” to infiltrate a suspected Taliban stronghold and rescue one Pvt. Grayson Jeffries, captured on routine patrol. Despite successful pacification of the stronghold (planned and directed by Valenzuela) Pvt. Jeffries was found KIA.
cp_intel/billet_associations_azur: -Equal partner with Jackals co-founder Viktor Metiko, AKA “Zane” – an apparently new partnership of convenience. Frequent tension has been observed between both operatives.
cp_intel/billet_associations_bale: -Served with brother Sgt. Maxim Bale, operator code name “Minotaur,” from Spetsnaz selection in 2005 until Kurbanov Hospital siege, 2009. The two were described as “inseparable” until SSgt. Bale’s injury and Minotaur’s discharge. Minotaur assignment with Allegiance requested by SSgt. Bale. (see CASE FILE SUBJECT: Operator A0102- Sgt. Maxim Ivanovich Bale)
cp_intel/billet_associations_charly: -Extensive operational history with Lt. Jacob Thorne, SAS. Friendship appears professional and platonic, but not invulnerable. Disagreement observed between operators over Thorne’s independent decision to release Jackals co-founder “Zane” from custody during Operation Iron Canopy.
cp_intel/billet_associations_dday: Enlisted operator Alice (then Task Force Orange) in 2014 to conduct an unsanctioned assault on a Taliban stronghold to rescue one Pvt. Grayson Jeffries. Jeffries, now suspected to be in an elicit relationship with DDay, had been captured during an ambush while under DDay’s command. Despite successful pacification of the stronghold, Pvt. Jeffries was found KIA. The elimination of a high value enemy target earned leniency for both operators- demotion for Alice, section 8 discharge for DDay.
cp_intel/billet_associations_domino: -Known to interact with Allegiance operator Syd on Armistice assignment in Verdansk. Developing relationship described as “competitive,” but amiable.
cp_intel/billet_associations_golem: -Served as superior officer to Allegiance operator Krueger (alias “Cpl. Josef Doss,” fmr. KSK) during Operation Nachtigall, Mozambique. Civilians found killed with 7.62 NATO rounds consistent with Krueger’s weapon, prompting KSK investigation and discovery of Krueger’s assumed identity. Krueger escaped custody before extradition. Lt. Blaustein was implicated in assisting escape - never formally charged.
cp_intel/billet_associations_grinch: -Terms of service brokered between Cpt. Zane and operator Grinch remain mostly hidden, “per the agreement struck” between parties, according to Cpt. Zane. Coalition intel reveals scheduled payments from known Jackals shell companies to an anonymous off-shore account in the Cayman Islands.
cp_intel/billet_associations_krueger: -Served in KSK 4th Platoon under Lt. Hans Rudolf Blaustein- Coalition code name “Golem.” KSK dossier indicates Blaustein befriended Krueger in effort to integrate him with the rest of his squad, claiming recognition of “talent in a troubled mind.” Friendship apparently ended after Krueger’s removal and subsequent escape from KSK custody. Aid/interference by Blaustein suspected. Evidence inconclusive.
cp_intel/billet_associations_minotaur: -Served with brother SSgt. Dmitry Bale, operator code name “Bale,” from Spetsnaz selection in 2005 until Kurbanov Hospital siege, 2009. Reportedly blamed himself for SSgt. Bale’s “death.” Allegiance psych-eval shows residual guilt for brother’s historic injury and perceived abandonment. (see CASE FILE SUBJECT: Operator A0101- SSgt. Dmitry Ivanovich Bale)
cp_intel/billet_associations_otter:
-Developed friendship with WARCOM operator 2nd Lt. Jackson Wyatt during joint SAS/Australian Special Forces operations in Afghanistan. Coalition psych-eval of operator Otter describes anti-social tendencies- suggests Wyatt friendship is unique.
-Intercepted AARs from Cpt. Price depict Otter as a ruthless, capable soldier, but often overzealous. “The lad’s a loose cannon. Needs a firm hand.”
cp_intel/billet_associations_raines:
-Connection to Sgt. Marcus Griggs difficult to trace. Case files indicate the two cooperated in an Operation code named “Sepulcher,” but documentation remains heavily classified. The speed of Sgt. Raines reassignment to Demon Dogs/Urzikstan may suggest a connection.
-Sgt.  Raines has taken an interest in Allegiance operative “Grinch", extending to independent research outside the battlefield.
cp_intel/billet_associations_rodion:
-Idealizes Spetsnaz veteran SSgt. Dmitry Ivanovich Bale, code name “Bale.”
-While serving with Armistice/Allegiance, Rodion has developed an unlikely rapport with CHIMERA operator Yegor Novak.
cp_intel/billet_associations_syd:
-CHIMERA leader and Allegiance asset code name “Nikolai,” claims to have met Syd in Bucharest during “an interesting bar fight.” No further details or corroborating evidence available.
-NOTE: During service with Armistice, Syd has reportedly developed a friendly rivalry with Sgt. Dominique Tam- Coalition code name "Domino"
cp_intel/billet_associations_thorne:
-Shares long operational history with Lt. Charlotte “Charly” Johnstone (SRR.)
-Known to have released Jackals Cmdr. Zane during Coalition Operation “Iron Canopy.”
cp_intel/billet_associations_wyatt: -Established friendship with Cpl. Benjamin “Otter” Lee (SAS) during joint SAS/Australian Special Forces operations in Afghanistan and Urzikstan.
cp_intel/billet_associations_yegor: -Long term associate and fixer for CHIMERA leader- Allegiance code name “Nikolai. Yegor appears loyal only to Nikolai, but surveillance indicates a rising frequency of challenges to Nikolai’s command- most surrounding the Chimera leader’s cooperation with Sgt. Kamarov of the Allegiance.
cp_intel/billet_associations_zane:
-Equal partner with Azur El-Sarraf, known Egyptian arms dealer. Partnership appears tenuous.
-Sole recruiter of Jackals operator “Grinch” – true identity unknown.
-Believed to have encountered Lt. Jacob Thorne, SAS, during 6/12/18 Coalition Operation “Iron Canopy,” intended to capture Jackals command. Lt. Thorne reported negative contact, contrary to anonymous report from Coalition sources.
cp_intel/billet_children_minotaur: (4 known) Long Vannak, Su Sokhem, Kalea Thawan, Suda Chao
cp_intel/billet_children_yegor: (3 known) Vira Chernysh, Lenora Pinchuk, Andriy Sokolov
cp_intel/billet_directive_alice: Maintain surveillance and close cooperation with subject Alice. Report any changes in relationship with operator DDay; identify potential weaknesses.
cp_intel/billet_directive_azur: Surveil and report activities to OCI Command. Observe conflict with Operator Zane and investigate root causes. Cooperate as-directed by Armistice leadership. DO NOT ENGAGE.
cp_intel/billet_directive_bale: Surveil and report activities to OCI Command. Recover intel on progress of current relations between operators Bale and Minotaur. Cooperate as-directed by Armistice leadership. DO NOT ENGAGE.
cp_intel/billet_directive_charly: Maintain surveillance and monitor communications. Encourage involvement of Allegiance operator Zane during SAS/Allegiance operations. Cooperate within Armistice guidelines- do not engage.
cp_intel/billet_directive_dday: Maintain surveillance and close cooperation with subject Alice. Report any changes in relationship with operator DDay; identify potential weaknesses.
cp_intel/billet_directive_domino: Maintain surveillance and monitor communications between operators Syd and Domino. Encourage close cooperation between the two. Operate within Armistice guidelines. Do not engage.
cp_intel/billet_directive_golem: Maintain surveillance and monitor communications between operators Golem and Krueger- high potential for leverage against WARCOM asset. Cooperate within Armistice guidelines. Do not engage.
cp_intel/billet_directive_grinch: Surveil and report activities to OCI Command. Apply specific attention to interactions between operators Zane and Grinch. Cooperate as-directed by Armistice leadership. DO NOT ENGAGE.
cp_intel/billet_directive_krueger: Surveil and report activities to OCI Command, including (but not limited to) contact with Coalition operator Golem. Cooperate as-directed by Armistice leadership. DO NOT ENGAGE.
cp_intel/billet_directive_minotaur: Surveil and report activities to OCI Command. Recover intel on progress of current relations between operators Bale and Minotaur. Cooperate as-directed by Armistice leadership. DO NOT ENGAGE.
cp_intel/billet_directive_otter: Maintain surveillance and monitor communications. Report ongoing psychological state and record any incidents- note apparent triggers. Cooperate within Armistice guidelines. Do not engage.
cp_intel/billet_directive_raines: Maintain surveillance and monitor communications where possible. Discourage any attempt to uncover intel on operator Grinch. Cooperate within Armistice guidelines but engage if necessary.
cp_intel/billet_directive_rodion: Surveil and report activities to OCI Command. Encourage positive interactions with Coalition forces, particularly American operators. Cooperate as-directed by Armistice leadership. DO NOT ENGAGE.
cp_intel/billet_directive_syd: Surveil and report activities to OCI Command, including (but not limited to) contact with Coalition Operator Domino. Explore potential to exploit western sympathies- parentage and family history off limits. Cooperate as-directed by Armistice leadership. DO NOT ENGAGE.
cp_intel/billet_directive_thorne: Maintain surveillance and monitor communications. Report interactions with Lt. Johnstone and relay any intercepted comms with Cpt. Price. Cooperate within Armistice guidelines- do not engage.
cp_intel/billet_directive_wyatt: Maintain surveillance and monitor communications between operators Otter and Wyatt. Report any unsanctioned/independent action taken by either. Operate within Armistice guidelines. Do not engage.
cp_intel/billet_directive_yegor: Surveil and report activities to OCI Command. Investigate potential to exploit anti-Allegiance sentiments and financial leverage. Cooperate as-directed by Armistice leadership. DO NOT ENGAGE.
cp_intel/billet_directive_zane: Surveil and report activities to OCI Command. Observe conflict with operator Azur, and report any interaction with Lt. Thorne, SAS. Cooperate as-directed by Armistice leadership. DO NOT ENGAGE.

cp_intel/billet_history_alice:
-Joined US Army at 18. Excelled in written, cognitive, and physical performance. 4 incident reports on file, reporting “disciplinary issues” and “problems with authority.”
-Entered and passed selection for Task Force Orange with noted reservation by Senior Drill Sergeant, SFC. William Griggs – cousin of Sgt. Marcus Griggs USMC. (Demon Dogs CO)
-Deployed to Afghanistan in 2010. Served with Task Force Orange for 4 years until incident in Kandahar province involving Coalition operator “DDay.” (see below)
-Reassigned to support roles for following 3 years, including training Afghan female soldiers.
-Filed numerous requests for combat assignment. Chosen for Demon Dogs in October 2019.
cp_intel/billet_history_azur:
-Known arms dealer, based in Alexandria, Egypt- active across Northern Africa from 2007 to present day.
-No formal military or combat experience prior. Began hiring private instructors after the murder of wife (Atiya) and children (Azima and Samman) at the hands of Al-Qatala enforcer Jamal Rahar, AKA “The Butcher;” an apparent reprisal over an arms deal with AQ rival CHIMERA.
-Following death of family, entered combat training by various private sources- western and eastern PMCs (CHIMERA included) over 6 years.
-Entered long-term partnership with pan-African revolutionary group “the Jackals,” consolidating influence across the continent. Currently less than 1 year of active involvement.
cp_intel/billet_history_bale:
-Served 14 total years in Spetsnaz, Spetsgruppa A – Alpha Group, Counter-Terrorism. Achieved rank of Stárshiy serzhánt (Staff Sergeant.)
-Gravely wounded (GSW, C6 spinal cord injury) during Kurbanov Hospital siege, 2nd Chechen War.
-Allowed to continue active duty in GRU administrative role. Fully rehabilitated over 5 years.
-Passed physical requirements for readmission into Alpha Group- April, 2014.
-Served 6 mo. under Gen. Barkov (Urzikstan) until filing formal complaint, citing civilian deaths.
cp_intel/billet_history_charly:
-Trained in tracking techniques from age 8 to 18 by father Cpt. Craig Johnstone, hunting poachers in Kenya and Tanzania.
-Joined British Army in 2005 to follow family tradition. Applied for and passed selection for the Special Reconnaissance Regiment (SRR.)
-Served multiple tours in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya. Paired with Lt. Jacob Micah Thorne, SAS, from 2011-present. Together, they maintain an 84.4% success rate (by Coalition figures.)
-Orchestrated the successful defense and liberation of a CIA safehouse in southern Urzikstan, earning a friend in Case Officer Kate Laswell, CIA.
-Al-Qatala attack on Piccadilly Circus solidified the SAS/SRR commitment to the Coalition. History with Laswell ensured assignment of operators Johnstone and Thorne.
cp_intel/billet_history_dday:
-Joined US Army on 18th birthday, 6 days after September 11th, 2001. Passed US Army Ranger school, May 2002. Deployed to Afghanistan in Operation Enduring Freedom, June 2002.
-Redeployed to Iraq for Operation Iraqi Freedom; fought in 1st and 2nd battles for Fallujah.
-Redeployed to Afghanistan for 2009 troop surge. Worked in extensive cooperation with Task Force Orange for 5 years until incident in Kandahar province involving Coalition operator “Alice.” (see below) Subsequently issued Section 8 Discharge, sent home to El Paso, TX.
-Returned to Afghanistan with PMC group Hadrian Defense Solutions. Recruited for Demon Dogs by Coalition operator Alice in October 2019.
cp_intel/billet_history_domino:
-Trained since 16 years of age to represent France in the Summer Olympics (Track and Field.) Failed to qualify for 2012. On track to qualify for 2016. Changed focus after Al-Qatala attacks on Paris, joining French Army.
-Selected for French Special Forces. Exhibited extraordinary physical fitness and cognitive ability. Broke 3 regiment records.
-Sent to Urzikstan in 2017 for first combat deployment, tasked with supporting Coalition forces.
-Hand-picked to represent France in WARCOM.
cp_intel/billet_history_golem:
-Raised in Oberstdorf, Germany. Taught the arts of bow hunting and wilderness tracking by father, Col. Daniel Blaustein, on frequent excursions into the German/Austrian Alps.
-Joined the Bundeswehr at 18, following family tradition established post World War 2.
-Passed selection for Kommando Spezialkräfte (KSK) 4th Platoon- special geographic operations.
-KSK deployments remain classified. Intel suggests operations in Mozambique, Urzikstan, and the Kastovian Mountains.
-Enjoys a sterling reputation with KSK, despite investigation of Operation Nachtigall (see below.)
cp_intel/billet_history_grinch:
-Training and military background unknown. Appears educated in both Coalition and Allegiance battle doctrines combined with self-taught survivalism.
-“Discovered” by Jackals patrol through the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) lead by Cpt. Zane (fmr. Nigerian Army, 7th Infantry Division.)
-3 Jackals fighters were reportedly killed by improvised traps and sniper fire while passing through a derelict jungle village occupied by Grinch. Cpt. Zane negotiated a cease fire and subsequent contract with operator Grinch. Currently 2 years of active service.
cp_intel/billet_history_krueger:
-Joined the German Bundeswehr under assumed identity “Josef Doss.” Now known to have been evading homicide charges in Salzburg, Austria (never convicted.)
-Received exceptional marks in Long Range Surveillance training and subsequent selection process for the Kommando Spezialkräfte (KSK.) Inducted into KSK 4th Platoon after 3 years.
-Removed from active duty pending court-martial for suspected role in civilian killings during 04/12/18 “Operation Nachtigall,” Mozambique. Escaped KSK custody 04/15.
-Fled to Eastern Europe (location unknown,) made contact with CHIMERA mercenary group. Entered long-term contract- currently 2 years in active service.
cp_intel/billet_history_minotaur:
-Served 5 total years in Spetsnaz, Spetsgruppa A – Alpha Group, Counter-Terrorism. Achieved rank of Serzhánt (Sergeant.)
-Witnessed wounding of brother SSgt. Dmitry Bale during Kurbanov Hospital siege, 2nd Chechen War (2009.) Falsely informed of brother Dmitry’s death. Discharged for psychological trauma.
-Spent following 10 years in and out of PMC groups operating in Southeast Asia under assumed alias Sergei Krovopuskov. Holds outstanding warrants for felonies in Cambodia, Laos, and Thailand.
-Tracked down by SSgt. Bale, July 2019. Requested for Allegiance Operator Status, Nov 2019.
cp_intel/billet_history_otter:
-Orphaned at 3 years of age, raised as a “ward of the state.” Juvenile criminal record includes several counts of larceny, burglary, vandalism, public intoxication, and aggravated assault.
-Gained international fame in June 2011 (aged 19.) Thwarted an Al-Qatala knife attack in Hyde Park, London- beat suspect unconscious while onlookers watched and recorded the event.
-Joined British Commandos in August 2011. Thrived in training. Entered SAS selection on recommendation by senior officers. Passed selection in January 2012.
-Deployed to operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Libya, Somalia, Yemen, and finally Urzikstan. Known to have served under Cpt. John Price in at least 7 operations.
cp_intel/billet_history_raines:
-Joined US Marine Corps in 2006. Received top marks in recruit training.
-Served as a Marine Radio Operator in the Iraq War 2007-2009, utilized in infantry, armored, and finally special reconnaissance. Developed reputation as a fearless, “laser-focused” Marine.
-Passed selection to become a Marine Raider. Served with distinction in Iraq until redeployment to Afghanistan, 2011-2015 assigned at the end to training Afghan Security Forces. Correspondence with family suggests retirement considered.
-Reached out to friend/fellow soldier Sgt. Marcus Griggs USMC (Demon Dogs) to solicit help in reassignment. Immediately referred/deployed to Urzikstan to serve with the Demon Dogs.
cp_intel/billet_history_rodion:
-Served 2 years in Spetsnaz 24th Special Purpose Brigade in Irkutsk, specializing in state-of-the-art and prototype weapons systems.
-Applied for selection into Spetsgruppa "B" or “Vympel,” specifically targeting a career in counter-terrorism operations. Cited desire to “fight real evil,” referring to Al-Qatala operations in Urzikstan and abroad.
-Passed Vympel selection after 18 months. Deployed directly into Allegiance active duty by request of Sgt. Kamarov- apparently hand-picked for expertise in Western culture.
-Verdansk appears to be first CT deployment in an active combat zone.
cp_intel/billet_history_syd:
-Joined US Army at 18, seeking overseas deployment and combat experience.
-Stationed by [REDACTED] request to Yambol Province, Bulgaria. Enrolled in every available training course during 4 year term of service (completed.)
-Records inconsistent over next 5 years. Reports indicate travel to conflict zones including (but not limited to) Ukraine, Urzikstan, and Mozambique. Presumed employment as a PMC.
-Signed long-term contract with CHIMERA- currently 1 year of active service.
cp_intel/billet_history_thorne:
-Joined the RAF at 18. Entered and passed SAS selection at 23, honoring family tradition.
-Served with distinction under Cpt. Johnathan Price, SAS for 3 years, operating in Iraq, Afghanistan, Urzikstan, and Kastovia (classified.)
-Formally filed for transfer from Cpt. Price’s command in 2011, citing ethical concerns. Reportedly present for the unsanctioned capture and interrogation of suspected ultranationalists in Kastovia.
-Chose officer’s track in effort to “lead by example.” Achieved rank of Lieutenant in 2014. Given command of an SAS platoon, and paired with Lt. Charlotte Johnstone (Charly) of the SRR.
-Hand-picked by the Director Special Forces (DSF) to represent the SAS in the Coalition. Intercepted messages indicate DSF intent to monitor Cpt. Price. Counter-intelligence possible.
cp_intel/billet_history_wyatt:
-Born in rural Tasmania- raised on long distance camping expeditions and wilderness training.
-Joined Australian Army with all 3 brothers in 2010. Each served full tours in Afghanistan- separate postings. Brothers returned to Tasmania.
-Chose a military career, accepted into Australian Special Forces – 1st Commando Regiment, October 2012.
-Known deployments in Afghanistan from 2012 to 2014, followed by operations in Urzikstan from 2015 to present day.
-Coalition psych-eval notes pronounced affinity for extreme, dangerous scenarios. Recommended for WARCOM/Coalition selection by Cpl. Benjamin “Otter” Lee (SAS.)
cp_intel/billet_history_yegor:
-Served full 2 year term in the Ukranian Naval Infantry.
-Entered private sector after discharge. Used Navy contacts across the Black Sea for both white and black market shipping. Came to deal exclusively in illegal arms and cigarettes.
-Forced out of Ukraine by former partners in the Sokolov Crime Family after reportedly refusing to broker a weapons deal with known ultranationalist Imran Zakhaev.
-Entered long-term contract with CHIMERA, expanding contacts across Eastern Europe- currently 8 years of active service.
cp_intel/billet_history_zane:
-Served 12 years in the Nigerian Army- 1 Division, 3 Armoured Division, and 7th Infantry Division. Achieved the rank of Captain.
-Resigned post April 2nd, 2016 in protest, having filed 3 formal complaints alleging misappropriation of foreign aid intended for the fight against Al-Qatala in West Africa.
-Left with brother, Abraham Metiko and founded the Jackals PMC Group. Began recruiting and training troops from across Africa “in defense of our countries, our families, and our way of life.”
-Financed primarily by black market petroleum and illegal arms sales, the Jackals are officially designated a “terrorist group” by the Nigerian Government and Coalition forces.

cp_intel/note_translation_ax:
Weeds setting deep roots in silver fields- more every day. Trees can’t grow there.
Trees thrive in the hills, sway over field and valley. Gather light while three suns shine.
No weeds in the yard. Trees shade the cabin at high tea.
cp_intel/note_translation_axv:
Trees fallen in the hills, shade gone, weeds taken root. Seed and poison, feed and kill, make roots dig deep. Keep weeds planted.
Grow and sway silent over three rivers- salt, steel, and sky. See what flows, gather light.
Do not fear death, offer your light. Weeds die, the forest remains.
cp_intel/note_translation_axx:
Death whispers- blackberry has been taken, no more shade at sunset. 
Blackberry saw weeds bring thorns to river sky- poisonous. May shine light on thief and devil.
Angels of death coming for blackberry. Seed and poison river salt, draw away from sky.
cp_intel/note_translation_oiii:
Angels of death burn weeds from soil. Roots, untouched, grow more. Forest already burning.
Thief and devil bring more than thorns, build safely in the shade. 
Sway over weeds, sway over rivers. Light the way for death- promises angels to follow.

SENDER: I know… I just don’t know what else to do. 

RECIPIENT “Baba”: Mustafa you’re my boy! Verdansk might not be it, but you’ll find your way. Take the night off, we’ll talk tomorrow. شِدّ حِيْلَك.

SENDER: night <3

Tuesday 03/03/2020, 1120 hours (GMT+3)

SENDER: Hey baba. Not sure if youll get this—we've been attacked. They say it’s Al-Qatala. I know youd want me to try to come home (Mom especially) but I can’t stop thnking about Uncle Tariq... He couldve left Urzikstan to be with us but he stayed and followed Karim. He fought for something. Now with this... My whole life, I wanted something to fight for and I think Ive finally found it. These people need my help. Don’t know how long its gonna take or if I’ll make it, but don’t be worried for me. Pray for Verdansk. شِدّ حِيْلَك  - Stafa

equipment/adrenaline_desc: Military stimulant that cauterizes combat wounds and refreshes Tactical Sprint.

Large explosive that sticks to surfaces and can be detonated remotely with [{ONFOOT:+frag}] when the equipment is depleted.

Double-tapping [{ONFOOT:+reload}] always detonates the explosives.

Large explosive that sticks to surfaces and can be detonated remotely with [{ONFOOT:+frag}] when the equipment is depleted.

Double-tapping [{COMMON:+activate}] always detonates the explosives.
equipment/decoy_desc: Counter-intel grenade that simulates fake gunfire and radar signatures that confuse the enemy.

equipment/molotov_desc: Improvised incendiary device that explodes on impact.
equipment/satchel_charge_desc:
Large explosive that sticks to surfaces and can be detonated remotely with [{ONFOOT:+frag}] when the equipment is depleted.
Double-tapping [{ONFOOT:+reload}] always detonates the explosives.
equipment/smoke_desc: Deploys a smoke screen that blocks vision.
equipment/snapshot_grenade_desc: Provides a momentary glimpse of enemies within the blast radius for your squad.
equipment/support_box_desc: Reload your gun with stopping power rounds that deal extra damage.
equipment/tac_insert_desc: Marks a location as your next spawn point.
equipment/thermite_desc: Explosive which burns fiercely for a short time after impact. Sticks to surfaces.
equipment/throwing_knife_desc: Retrievable knife that can be thrown to quickly and quietly eliminate enemies.
equipment/throwing_knife_drill_desc: Retrievable knife that is lethal on impact. Note: This equipment can be obtained from the Saw Bundle when available in the store and has no functional difference from the ^5Throwing Knife^7, change is visual only.
equipment/throwing_knife_electric_desc: Retrievable knife that is lethal on impact. Note: This equipment can be obtained from the Dr. Karlov Lives Bundle when available in the store and has no functional difference from the ^5Throwing Knife^7, change is visual only.

equipment/trophy_desc: Deployable autonomous defense system that destroys up to three nearby pieces of equipment and projectiles.
equipment/white_phosphorus_grenade_desc: Obscures an area in a white fog and burns those who come close.

Buy this digital current-gen version of Call of Duty®: Vanguard and download the next-gen version at no extra cost when it launches.

The iconic Black Ops series is back with Call of Duty®: Vanguard - the direct sequel to the original and fan-favorite Call of Duty®: Black Ops.

Vanguard will drop fans into the depths of the Cold War’s volatile geopolitical battle of the early 1980s. Nothing is ever as it seems in a gripping single-player Campaign, where players will come face-to-face with historical figures and hard truths, as they battle around the globe through iconic locales like East Berlin, Vietnam, Turkey, Soviet KGB headquarters and more.

As elite operatives, you will follow the trail of a shadowy figure named Perseus who is on a mission to destabilize the global balance of power and change the course of history. Descend into the dark center of this global conspiracy alongside iconic characters Woods, Mason and Hudson and a new cast of operatives attempting to stop a plot decades in the making.

Beyond the Campaign, players will bring a Cold War arsenal of weapons and equipment into the next generation of Multiplayer and Zombies experiences.

Welcome to the brink. Welcome to Call of Duty®: Vanguard.


**Offer content and availability may vary by region and is subject to change. Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare®/Call of Duty®: Warzone™ required to redeem offer. Sold/downloaded separately. Must be redeemed by November 13th 2021.

killstreak/ac130_desc: Be the gunner in a close air support gunship. Cooldown: 90 sec

killstreak/chopper_gunner_desc: Be the gunner in a close air support helicopter. Cooldown: 60 sec
killstreak/cuav_desc: Scramble enemy mini-maps and disable hostile Missile Turrets for a short time. Cooldown: 60 sec
killstreak/dart_desc: Pilot an anti-personnel drone. Remote detonate the drone with ^3[{+attack}]^7 or detonate on impact.
killstreak/drone_squadron_desc: Call in a squadron of autonomous drones outfitted with machine gun turrets.
killstreak/heavy_attack_chopper_desc: A heavily armed and armored helicopter provides air support.
killstreak/hoverjet_desc: Lay waste to enemy infantry and vehicles from the cockpit of a powerful VTOL jet. Cooldown: 90 sec
killstreak/jetfighter_desc: Call in a squadron of jets to attack enemy air Scorestreaks. Counter enemy Air Patrols. Cooldown: 0 sec
killstreak/napalm_strike_desc: Launch a targeted carpet bomb strike of explosive napalm. Cooldown: 30 sec
killstreak/overwatch_snipers_desc: Call in the support of 2 heli snipers.
killstreak/planemortar_desc: Launch three targeted artillery strikes. Unused strikes can be saved for later. Cooldown: 30 sec
killstreak/recon_plane_desc: High-Altitude Reconnaissance Plane that shows both enemy position and direction on the mini-map. Cooldown: 60 sec
killstreak/remote_missile_desc: Steer a trio of missiles with boost and air brake controls. Secondary missiles auto-fire at painted targets. Cooldown: 90 sec
killstreak/straferun_desc: AI piloted strafe run that lays heavy machine gun and rocket fire. Cooldown: 30 sec
killstreak/uav_desc: Reveal enemy positions through the Fog of War. Cooldown: 90 sec

korean_legal/korean_pi_body_0:
LIST OF COLLECTED PERSONAL DATA AND COLLECTION METHOD
Activision Publishing, Inc. (hereinafter referred to as "Activision", located in the United States, contact: privacy@activision.com) collects (including receiving data from Blizzard Entertainment, Ltd. and its group companies) and uses your personal data to the minimum extent that is necessary to provide our services to you. Activision transfers collected personal data overseas upon your purchase and usage of services by online transmission to provide its services. You have a right to refuse this consent form. Even when you do not enter personal data that is optional, there is no limitation on your use of our services. However, Activision’s service shall be restricted if you don't agree to this essential consent for PI processing.
korean_legal/korean_pi_body_1:
Required Items Collected Through Blizzard
·	BattleTag and Blizzard Account information
·	Regional information
·	Relevant Blizzard service purchase and usage information

Required Items Collected by Activision for Call of Duty Account
·	Region, Email address, Password and Display name
Automatically Collected Items
·	IP address, unauthorized usage log, access log, cookie
korean_legal/korean_pi_body_2:
PURPOSE OF COLLECTION AND USAGE OF PERSONAL DATA
We use the information we collect to operate Activision Services; to operate communication service and online play among players over platforms; to deliver the items and services you have requested; to enhance, improve, operate, and maintain Activision Services, our games, and our other systems, resources, and products; to prevent fraudulent use of Activision Services; to tailor your user experience, and the content and advertisements that are presented to you; to maintain a record of our dealings with you, and for other administrative purposes.

For improvement of users' game experience and management of users' in-game relationship, non-identifiable data along with Battle Tag may be disclosed to other users through open API or in-game interface, including game data generated during user's usage of Activision's services.
korean_legal/korean_pi_body_3:
PERIOD OF RETENTION AND USAGE
Activision will hold your personal information until termination of service.
In addition, if Activision needs to retain such data to comply with relevant laws or regulations, Activision will retain the data for the period set under such laws or regulations.
For any privacy policy or personal data-related inquiries, please send an e-mail to privacy@activision.com.

lua_menu/accessory001_desc: It's got all the twiddly knobs, the fancy band and something called a bezel. Treasure it.
lua_menu/accessory005_desc: How many kills until I get the nuke? Now you don't have to ask anymore - just look at your watch.
lua_menu/accessory006_desc: A pet watch that lets you hatch and look after your very own monster. It's a game within a game.
lua_menu/accessory007_desc: Once you've drawn your last breath, the step counter will act as a memorial... until the battery runs out.
lua_menu/accessory008_desc: You HAVE time to kill, or it IS time to kill? Your choice with this functional timepiece which tracks your K/D.
lua_menu/accessory0101_desc: Sail into darkness with the Black Sea Watch.
lua_menu/accessory0102_desc: Careful not to drop the Desert Sands Watch on the beach, you may never find it again.
lua_menu/accessory0103_desc: Time your victory with the Mangrove Watch.
lua_menu/accessory0104_desc: There's only one time that matters with the Sublime Watch... Just check your wrist.
lua_menu/accessory0105_desc: Keep track of the long con with the Ruse Watch.
lua_menu/accessory0106_desc: The Time of The Season Watch is perfect if you've ever wanted a swarm of bats on your wrist while you keep an eye on the clock.
lua_menu/accessory0107_desc: Keep your cool with the Aletsch Watch.
lua_menu/accessory0108_desc: See them in a whole new light with the Kaleidoscope Watch.
lua_menu/accessory010_desc: When your back is against the wall - it's time to crunch!
lua_menu/accessory011_desc: Stay hungry with the Dinner Time watch.
lua_menu/accessory0129_desc: The flashiest watch to come to Verdansk. The Whirlwind.
lua_menu/accessory012_desc: Always be on time with the Time Frame Watch.
lua_menu/accessory013_desc: Bask in the splendor of the Golden Grandeur watch
lua_menu/accessory014_desc: Strong, reliable, and readable yet impeccably beautiful. Handcrafted to the highest of standards.
lua_menu/accessory015_desc: Thank you for participating in the Season 3 drops program!
lua_menu/accessory016_desc: Not only does this watch tell perfect time but it keeps track of your progress through the ranks.
lua_menu/accessory018_desc: Show off your true colors and your impeccable timekeeping skills, all in one chronographic triumph.
lua_menu/accessory019_desc: Analogue precision + soft, glow-in-the-dark hands = the night raid operator's best friend.
lua_menu/accessory020_desc:
Thank you for supporting our veterans!
Visit callofdutyendowment.org to learn more
lua_menu/accessory021_desc: Never lose track of the real time or date with the Digital Ink Watch - good for both martial and marital situational awareness.
lua_menu/accessory022_desc: This one is for people who appreciate simplicity. It's retro, it looks cool and it tells the time.
lua_menu/accessory023_desc: There’s never anything better than a black edition—and whatever may hatch from the Tomogunchi Black will be no exception.
lua_menu/accessory024_desc: Track your in-game steps and heart rate while you track your enemies - the watch keeps you honest.
lua_menu/accessory025_desc: Time is the fire in which our K/D ratios burn. Keep track of it all with the Time to Die watch.
lua_menu/accessory027_desc: Father Time is as old as the hills. This watch's retro look belies its stellar performance, however.
lua_menu/accessory028_desc: This watch ranks as one of the most progressive out there. Oh, and it shows your rank progress too.
lua_menu/accessory029_desc: You're always mission-aware with the Tactics Tracker Watch.
lua_menu/accessory030_desc: Show them what you've got with the Emblem Precision II Watch which displays your currently equipped Emblem on its face.
lua_menu/accessory031_desc: A hidden engraving in the rear plate reads: "Five long years he wore this watch..."
lua_menu/accessory033_desc: Any watch will tell the time, but few do it in as classy a manner as the Inotay Retro.
lua_menu/accessory034_desc: Count down to the apocalypse with the Radioactive Watch, which tracks your progress towards a Tactical Nuke.
lua_menu/accessory035_desc: Get a little extra time with the Freeze Frame Watch.
lua_menu/accessory050_desc: Spring forward or fall back with the Time Traveler Watch.
lua_menu/accessory053_desc: Don't get caught hibernating with the Ursa Minor Watch.
lua_menu/accessory054_desc: No need to watch the sun. Use the Blue Skies Watch, son.
lua_menu/accessory055_desc: The Clepsydra Watch would no doubt be as useful underwater as above it. It's just, how would you test something like that?
lua_menu/accessory056_desc: Times are changing, just check your watch.
lua_menu/accessory057_desc: Time to watch the world burn. Introducing the Swiftlet Watch.
lua_menu/accessory058_desc: Take it one thing at a time with the Red Barchetta Watch.
lua_menu/accessory059_desc: The biological clock is a ticking timebomb. Keep an eye on it with the Acid Rain Watch.
lua_menu/accessory060_desc: Keep track of the tides of battle with the Flood Plain Watch.
lua_menu/accessory061_desc: They'll wind up dead when you wear the Winding Skull Watch.
lua_menu/accessory062_desc: Plans will go like clockwork when you all synchronize with the Hammer Down Watch.
lua_menu/accessory063_desc: Colorful dreams and sleeping on the job? Prevent malfunctions with the Chromatose Watch.
lua_menu/accessory064_desc: It’s always a bloody good time with the Blood Simple Watch.
lua_menu/accessory065_desc: Beat more than Father Time with the Red Ratio Watch and keep track of your K/D ratio while you're at it.
lua_menu/accessory066_desc: The Call of Duty: Mobile Watch is featherweight, reliable, and obnoxiously hard to lose.
lua_menu/accessory067_desc: They don't know it yet, but they're living on borrowed time when you're wearing the Jackals Watch.
lua_menu/accessory068_desc: The fabled Chimera is a cobbled-together animal – which is in stark contrast to the beautiful precision analog timepiece.
lua_menu/accessory069_desc: It's been calculated that one human hour equates to seven dog hours. The Demon Dogs Watch keeps regular people time however.
lua_menu/accessory070_desc: Come correct and get buttoned up with the Warcom Watch.
lua_menu/accessory071_desc: The SAS Watch embodies one trait above all others: dependability
lua_menu/accessory072_desc: In Communist Russia, time kills you. The Spetsnaz Watch.
lua_menu/accessory073_desc: Evolve your pet after each match to unlock corresponding pet charms. Make sure to keep your pet good and fed!
lua_menu/accessory074_desc: Make sure your opponents never miss their appointment with death when you wear your A Time To Reap Watch.
lua_menu/accessory075_desc: Get mean with the Goblin Watch.
lua_menu/accessory076_desc: Always keep spatial awareness when utilizing the Mini Map watch.
lua_menu/accessory077_desc: Don't you just love seeing how stuff works? The Sortie Watch.
lua_menu/accessory079_desc: Take no time off with the Willpower Watch.
lua_menu/accessory080_desc: Break them down with your Oxidized Watch.
lua_menu/accessory081_desc: Your opponents will never miss their appointment with death when you rock the Redline Watch.
lua_menu/accessory082_desc: Give out more than red cards with the Injury Time Watch.
lua_menu/accessory083_desc: Timing is everything with the Steadfast Watch.
lua_menu/accessory084_desc: Look for a sign with the Foreshadow Watch. Results may vary.

lua_menu_fisher/arthur_background: Arthur was born in Cameroon to a wealthy noble family. He was educated in England at Cambridge, where he studied international affairs. Detesting fascism, he joined the British military to fight the Nazis and liberate Europe. After proving his leadership in Operation Tonga, Arthur was chosen to lead a new team of international soldiers. He was the first recruit of the SOTF.
lua_menu_fisher/beatrice_background: As a child, Béatrice went to bed each night listening to her mother read stories, sparking a passion for learning that fueled her career as a teacher. Béatrice saw her fiancé and her students jailed during a mass arrest of Jewish families. Horrified by the atrocities of fascism, she took up arms and joined the French resistance. She fought in the liberation of Paris and was eventually reunited with her love.
lua_menu_fisher/constanze_background: Constanze was born in Dusseldorf to two loving parents. When she was ten, the Nazis rose to power and she was forced to don the BDM uniform, but defied her superiors at every turn. In Poland, she met a girl — a Polish resistance fighter — and they fell in love. Years later, she joined the SOE alongside her Polish lover and helped punch a hole through the German defensive line in support of the Allied invasion.
lua_menu_fisher/daniel_background: Daniel was born to two Japanese immigrants who ran an auto shop in Los Angeles. After the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, the US government took away his family’s home and business, then incarcerated them in a concentration camp. Despite the mistrust of his own nation, Daniel was drafted into service to protect it. He was deployed as a sniper in Italy as part of a segregated unit of Japanese-Americans.
lua_menu_fisher/francis_background: Francis Lanakila was born and raised Oahu, Hawaii. He fought with the 442nd Regimental Combat Team and the 100th Battalion in the Vosges Mountains. After serving as a guard at the Sand Island Detention Camp, he was horrified to learn from detained Japanese-Americans of the inhumane treatment they received, and he vowed then and there to fight for a better world.
lua_menu_fisher/halima_background: Halima was born in Mogadishu to a Somali mother and an influential Italian fascist. Her family moved to Italy where they lived in luxury. After her family returned to Somalia, Halima witnessed the harsh reality of authoritarian rule and the cruelty of colonialism. Instead of fleeing with her family, Halima joined the Somali resistance to fight the Italian occupation.
lua_menu_fisher/isabella_background: Isabella had a close relationship with her father who taught her martial arts during her childhood. Together, they practiced hand-to-hand combat, fighting with sticks, knives, and blades, and learning weapon techniques. In 1942, her world changed forever when he was captured and killed during the war. Overcome with grief, she utilized her training and joined the Hukbalahap Resistance to bring justice for her father.
lua_menu_fisher/lewis_background: Lewis was born in Bayou La Batre in Mobile County Alabama, and grew up fishing with his brother. In 1942, both he and his brother were drafted into separate units for the war. Lewis made his mark as a sniper, and was known to be quiet, but effective. He hoped his resourcefulness and careful consideration on the battlefield would help to keep both himself, and his fellow soldiers safe.
lua_menu_fisher/lucas_background: Lucas is a sweetheart with a sweet tooth. He was born on a sheep farm just outside of Melbourne, Australia, and while he loved his home, he always dreamed of seeing the world. When the Second World War began, he didn’t hesitate to sign up and join the fight. Lucas is a gentle giant who prefers explosive methods of problem solving.
lua_menu_fisher/lucas_hobbies: Competitive sheep shearing, eating lamingtons, playing cards
lua_menu_fisher/padma_background: Padmavati was born in India during the British Raj. Her family labored for wealthy foreigners who dictated their lives. She found joy in music and poetry, which fostered her idealism and strengthened her disgust with colonial rule. By joining the Indian National Army to fight the British occupation, Padmavati found her true calling. She became a warrior poet on the battlefield, inspiring others with her courage.
lua_menu_fisher/padma_hobbies: Writing poetry, singing folk songs, playing the Swarmandal
lua_menu_fisher/polina_background: Polina was a quiet girl, born and raised in Stalingrad. In 1942, she assisted the war effort as a nurse for the Medical Support Battalion, but during the Nazi invasion of Stalingrad, she joined the fight as a deadly sniper. Her rage is fueled by her grief, loneliness, and need for vengeance. She will stop at nothing to make sure evil men know true suffering.
lua_menu_fisher/quip_roland_16: Let my gun do the talking
lua_menu_fisher/roland_background: Roland was forcibly conscripted by the German Army after the invasion of Luxembourg. He reluctantly served in order to keep his family safe. When the Nazis betrayed him and sent his family to a concentration camp, Roland deserted his post and rampaged through Europe to save his loved ones. Sadly, he failed to rescue them. Roland’s vengeful path earned him the attention of Butcher, who recruited him to a new cause.
lua_menu_fisher/roland_hobbies: Playing cards, reading books on history and military campaigns

lua_menu_fisher/s4_solange_01_background: An exceptional track runner and physics student, Solange excelled at university life. lua_menu_sierra/t9adler_background: Trained as a Green Beret, Adler entered the CIA’s Special Activities Division in 1959, after which he only appears sporadically in the Agency’s records. While an undisputed leader, he is an enigma to all that serve with him.
lua_menu_sierra/t9cia_background: A technological genius with special forces training, Sims joined MACV-SOG in 1967, serving on Russell Adler’s team in Vietnam. He always provides a steady hand and sense of humor under pressure, no matter the circumstances.
lua_menu_sierra/t9cub_background: Growing up on the streets before joining a pro-revolutionary street gang, Garcia is a ruthless assassin employed by the DGI.  His face is the last thing his victims see, as he coldly watches the light go out in their eyes.
lua_menu_sierra/t9kgb_background: A child mathematical genius, Portnova worked in cryptography before being inducted into KGB Directorate V.  Brilliant, deadly, and fanatically loyal to the state, she represents a threat either on or off the battlefield.
lua_menu_sierra/t9mi6_background: While studying as a young prodigy at Oxford, Park lost her brother to a terrorist attack. With new focus she joined MI6, and quickly became one of their leading experts on international paramilitary organizations.
lua_menu_sierra/t9navyseal_background: Reluctantly following in his father’s footsteps, Baker enlisted and qualified as a Navy SEAL. He saw action in Operation Condor as a Scout Sniper. His temper never bothered Adler, who recruited him to help hunt down Perseus.
lua_menu_sierra/t9st1_background: First generation of his family born on US soil; his father served as a translator for US forces during the Korean War. Enlisted 1977, volunteered and passed selection for the US Army Rangers 1979.
lua_menu_sierra/t9st3_background: Member of the 22 SAS Special Projects Team, trained in Hostage Rescue and CQB Tactics. Dishonorably discharged, he became a mercenary selling his skills to the highest bidder. His service records remain classified.
lua_menu_sierra/t9st5_background: Former Marine Lieutenant Powers was accused of being a foreign agent and fled to the USSR. It remains plausible that the CIA may have engineered the scenario, attempting to embed her within the Soviet intelligence apparatus.
lua_menu_sierra/t9west_background: Expert in demolitions and bomb disposal, Beck is a tactical operator serving in Diensteinheit IX.  Calm and dependable, he defuses tense situations with the dry humor of someone who regularly handles explosives.
lua_menu_sierra/t9woods_background: A self-reliant loner resulting from a youth spent on the streets, Woods trained as a Marine before entering the CIA’s Special Activities Division. Years spent as a POW in Vietnam prove his sheer resilience.

lua_menu_tango/t9bulldozer_background: A highly skilled member of a US Marine Corps Special Reaction Team, Bulldozer is a CQB and hostage rescue expert. Always first in the fight, Bulldozer strives to protect the defenseless and serves with distinction.

lua_menu_victor/t9maxis_background: Former BND agent Maxis is something of an enigma to her fellow Operators. Despite delivering outstanding results in the field, her independent streak, and the gaps in her background, frequently confound her superiors.
lua_menu_victor/t9naga_background: A former warlord, grown rich trafficking drugs and weapons through the Golden Triangle. Feared by his men for his temper and brutality. Recruited by Perseus to move WMDs around the globe using his established supply lines.
lua_menu_victor/t9rivas_background: As a child Rivas saw firsthand the deadly consequences that the Menendez Cartel’s wars with rival gangs had on their neighboring communities.  She has dedicated her life to ridding her country of the Cartel’s influence.
lua_menu_victor/t9wolf_background: Wolf learned to hunt in the bayous surrounding his grandparent’s Louisiana home. Entering service on his 18th birthday in memory of his fallen brother, he now stalks more dangerous prey as an elite Delta Force sniper.

lua_menu_wz315/isabella_background: Isabella had a close relationship with her father who taught her martial arts during her childhood. Together, they practiced hand-to-hand combat, fighting with sticks, knives, and blades, and learning weapon techniques. In 1942, her world changed forever when he was captured and killed during the war. Overcome with grief, she utilized her training and joined the Hukbalahap Resistance to bring justice for her father.
lua_menu_wz320/anna_background: Anna grew up in Vienna with a close-knit family. She loved the wild places, the dark forests and cold peaks of Austria. During the Anschluss, Anna was forced into a labor camp and made to toil for those who murdered her family. With nothing left to lose, Anna improvised an explosive at the ammunition factory in her labor camp, and detonated it as a distraction for her escape. She returned to Vienna and joined the resistance with the Ö5 network.
lua_menu_wz320/quip_thomas_58: Why are you even out here
lua_menu_wz320/thomas_background: Thomas was born in New Carlisle, Quebec to a French father and a Spanish mother. He fought in World War 1, served as a volunteer for the Mackenzie-Papineau Battalion, and drove tanks in World War 2. His battle experience hardened him, but only out of care for his soldiers in an attempt to send everyone back home. He loves his partner and is optimistic about returning to him after the war.
lua_menu_wz325/gustavo_background: A wealthy playboy, Gustavo dos Santos fled Brazil to be a frivolous socialite in Paris. After a chance encounter with a French resistance agent revealed Germany's secret plans for Brazil, Gustavo risked his life to deliver the intelligence to his homeland. He joined "The Smoking Cobras" (also known as the Brazilian Expeditionary Force) and took Monte Castello, the last line of Nazi defenses in Northern Italy.

lua_menu_wz326/lion_background: Growing up in Long Beach, California, Snoop Dogg realized he had a talent for rapping at a young age and began to pursue it as a career. Now, he is still releasing music and appearing as a media personality on multiple shows, but in his free time, he chooses to fight as an operator in Call of Duty.

lua_menu_wz330/florence_background: Born and raised in Alabama, Florence dreamed of representing her country as a fighter pilot since she was a little girl. During WWII, she was determined to make those dreams come true, but was turned away from those opportunities due to both her gender and race. After the war, the SOTF recognized her talent and passion for being in the sky and Florence has flown as a rescue helicopter pilot for them ever since.
lua_menu_wz330/mateo_background: Mateo was born into a large immigrant family in Texas, dreaming of becoming a civil engineer. He joined the Navy during World War II, fighting as a tail gunner in the Pacific. After witnessing growing prejudice and racism against his people following the war, Mateo threw himself into campaigning for his people, speaking out against these injustices as well as helping reunite families across the Mexican border.

A former star high school athlete, Lazar has explosive power and athleticism in bounds, but peers are quick to cite his mental quickness and steady disposition as the primary reason to want him at your back.

lua_menu_wz340/callum_background: All his life, Callum was a showoff, constantly adventuring and getting into trouble with neighbors, woodland creatures, the law – everyone. His unwavering spirit helped him quickly ascend the ranks of the British Army to eventually become a recruit trainer. In World War II, Callum, harboring deep hatred for Nazis and their ideals, fought hard for a future without them. Currently he is the trainer for all SOTF agents.
lua_menu_wz340/carver_background: Butcher served in the British Army during Operation Devon, battling against the 16th Panzer Division. He was dismissed after sustaining injuries to his face from exploding shrapnel but returned to the front lines soon after as duty called. There he witnessed resistance fighters in action. Inspired, he went on to become the founder and recruiter for the Special Operations Task Force. The rest, as they say, is history.

lua_menu_wz345/doggett_background: Also a product of Skynet, the T-1000 is an advanced AI model made from liquid metal.  Its passion is infiltrating the human resistance, its focus is terminating their members, and it is relentless in both of these pursuits.

lua_menu_wz345/ikenna_background: Ikenna Olowe understood strategy from a young age. As a child in Nigeria, he excelled at chess, quickly surpassing his teachers. He grew strong studying Gidigbo, a martial battle of wits. Balanced in body and mind, Ikenna joined the war effort as a battlefield engineer. His work established critical supplies lines across the globe. Ikenna became a grand planner, knowing when to build and when to demolish.

lua_menu_wz345/palmer_background: The T-800 is described by Skynet as the first cybernetic organism, perfectly able to blend in with humans as it has living tissue over a hyper alloy skeleton.  After a mid-life crisis, its passion becomes protecting John Connor, acting like a stepfather to him.  Its focus is terminating threats, and yet it has no preferred fighting style: it is comfortable with weapons, vehicles and even hand to hand combat.

lua_menu_wz350/khaled_background: Khaled Al-Asad grew up in Urzikstan amid political strife. He was drawn to the words of Omar Sulaman, and joined the Al-Qatala terrorist group. He was imprisoned, but escaped after Sulaman’s death to take control of Al-Qatala. His leadership transformed the militants into an army, as he acquired an arsenal for the invasion of Verdansk. Al-Asad was responsible for the gas attacks in Verdansk that crippled the region.

lua_menu_wz350/raul_background: Raul Menendez was born in Nicaragua, where his childhood was clouded by the brutal revolution of US-backed Contras. His father founded the Menendez Cartel and was assassinated by the CIA at the height of his power. Raul focused his rage and took control of the cartel. He matured into a hostile political activist. His charisma and ruthlessness propelled him to leadership of the terrorist group Cordis Die.

lua_menu_wz355/gabriel_background: Gabriel Rorke graduated from the US Naval Academy and became a Captain in the Marines. During an assassination mission in Caracas, Venezuela, Rorke braved the flooding city to locate and kill General Diego Almagro, leader of the Federation. During the chaos of his squad’s extraction, Rorke was left behind. He was found by The Federation, who brainwashed away his loyalties, turning him into a man with an undying vendetta against his own.

lua_menu_wz355/seraph_background: Seraph grew up in the Singapore Quarantine Zone, daughter of a high ranking officer of the 54 Immortals. She honored her lineage and excelled within the syndicate becoming its youngest ever Enforcer. She is a living embodiment of the 54I's will, strictly quelling dissent within its ranks, while projecting the syndicate’s force and ambition wherever it's needed. Her dedication and skills are unmatched, as she proved when she willingly offered her own arm in return for the honor of receiving a cybernetic limb from the 54I.

lua_menu_xray/t9spetsnaz_background: A former hitman, Antonov entered the military to reduce his sentence. Distrusted by his squad because of his criminal past, he finds himself assigned the duties no one else wants; bomb defusal and hazmat work.
lua_menu_xray/t9wraith_background: An ex Norwegian Intelligence Service Operator, Wraith is a patriot disillusioned with the balance of the Cold War. Expert in infiltration and sabotage, she fights to destroy the World Order and rebuild from the ashes.

menu/ads_auto_aim_desc:
^5Disabled:^7 The camera does not snap automatically when Aiming Down Sight.

^5Enabled:^7 The camera snaps automatically to an enemy if your crosshair is located near them while entering ADS.

^3This option is only available in Campaign mode.^7
menu/ads_fov_description:
^5Independent:^7 Aiming Down Sights zooms the field of view to its usual value.

^5Affected:^7 Aiming Down Sights zooms to a value closer to the Field of View setting.
menu/ads_mouse_sensitivity_desc:
Defines which algorithm is used for the mouse sensitivity when Aiming Down Sights.

^5Legacy:^7 When Aiming Down Sights, your rotation speed is reduced based on your new field of view. This is how it worked in previous titles.

^5Relative:^7 Like Legacy, but your rotation speed is adjusted to travel a specific monitor distance with the same mouse movement, no matter your zoom level. This distance can be adjusted with the ^5Monitor Distance Coefficient^7 setting.
menu/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_2x_desc:
Further customize the mouse sensitivity while ^5Aiming Down Sights^7. Only applies to ^52x^7 magnification levels.

Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.

Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.

menu/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_descript:
Choose at which moment the mouse sensitivity changes when transitioning from hipfire to Aiming Down Sights.

^5Instant:^7 Sensitivity multiplier is applied immediately when Aiming Down Sights.

^5Gradual:^7 Sensitivity multiplier is progressively applied when alternating between hipfire to fully zoomed in.

^5After Zoom:^7 Sensitivity multiplier is applied only when fully zoomed in.
