menu/aim_assist_desc:
^5Disabled:^7 Disable aim assist.

^5Standard:^7 Traditional aim slowdown near target.

^5Precision:^7 Strong aim slowdown that only kicks in when aiming closer to target.  Best for accurate players.

^5Focusing:^7 Strong aim slowdown that also kicks in when narrowly missing target.  Best for players new to analog aiming.
menu/aim_assist_fov_scale_desc:
^5Disabled:^7 Aim assist region doesn't scale according to field of view (FOV).

^5Enabled:^7 Aim assist region rescales according to FOV.
menu/aim_down_sight_desc:
^5Hold:^7 Press and hold to aim down sight.

^5Toggle:^7 Press to aim down sight. Press again to stop.
menu/aim_down_the_sight_autoaim: Autoaim when Aiming Down the Sight
menu/air_veh_adv_ctrl_desc:

^3This action is only available in Warzone.^7

menu/armor_plate_behavior_desc:
^5Apply One:^7 Press to apply one armor plate. Press multiple times to use one armor plate after the other until you have maximum armor capacity or have run out or armor plates.

^5Apply All:^7 Press once to apply one armor plate after the other until you have maximum armor capacity or have run out of armor plates.

By default, ^5this keybind is linked to Use Killstreak/Munition 2^7 in Killstreaks & Vehicles sub-category.

^3This action is only available in Warzone mode.^7
menu/armor_plate_slot_desc:
Press to use the armor plate. Press multiple times to use one armor plate after the other until you have maximum armor capacity or have run out of armor plates.

By default, ^5this keybind is linked to Use Killstreak/Munition 2^7 in Killstreaks & Vehicles sub-category.

menu/auto_forward_desc: Press to continuously move forward. Press again, or press Move Forward, or press Move Backward to stop.
menu/auto_forward_enabled_gamepad_desc:
^5Enabled:^7 Push the movement stick forward twice in quick succession to continuously move forward, pull backwards to stop.

^5Disabled:^7 Disable the Auto Move Forward feature for Controller.
menu/automatic_airborne_mantle_desc:
^5Disabled:^7 Hold Jump or double tap Jump to initiate a mantle while airborne.

^5Enabled:^7 Automatically mantles while airborne when possible. No input is required.
menu/automatic_mantle_desc:
^5Enabled:^7 If you are moving in the direction of a reachable edge while your character is airborne, you will automatically mantle over that edge.

^5Disabled:^7 You will never mantle unless you press or hold a mantle keybind at the appropriate moment.
menu/automatic_sprint_gamepad_desc:
^5Disabled:^7 Sprint is activated manually with the Sprint button.

^5Automatic Sprint:^7 Move Forward while standing to make your character automatically sprint. Double press the Sprint button while sprinting to activate the Tactical Sprint.

^5Automatic Tactical Sprint:^7 Move Forward while standing to make your character automatically activate Tactical Sprint.

Note that Automatic Sprint will not change your current stance (e.g.: crouched, prone) and will not cancel other actions in progress (e.g.: reloading, aiming down sights).
menu/automatic_sprint_kbm_desc:
^5Disabled:^7 Sprint is activated manually with the Sprint keybind.

^5Automatic Sprint:^7 Pressing the Move Forward keybind while standing makes your character automatically sprint. Use the Sprint or Tactical Sprint keybind while sprinting to activate the Tactical Sprint. 

^5Automatic Tactical Sprint:^7 Move Forward while standing to make your character automatically Tactical Sprint.

Note that Automatic Sprint will not change your current stance (e.g.: crouched, prone) and will not cancel other actions in progress (e.g.: reloading, aiming down sights).
menu/automatic_weapon_switch_desc:
^5Disabled:^7 You must manually switch weapons when ammo is depleted.

^5Enabled:^7 Weapon automatically switches when you are trying to fire while ammo is depleted.

menu_sp/vf_file_01_body:
CIA - HR3650092326177 // PSYCHIATRIC REPORT - 10/02

Patient:  GABRIEL T. RORKE
Rank: Captain - ACTIVE DUTY

GABRIEL RORKE was involved in Operation: Sand Viper, and is one of only fifteen operators who survived the conflict.  For the past year, the traumatizing experience seems to have no effect on his combat readiness or mental sharpness.

If anything, I would say the experience has given him purpose.  He seems more focused than ever.  Calm.  It's really quite inspiring, actually.  Most soldiers I've come across have "dead" eyes - they just look right through me, as if I'm not even there.

Captain Rorke displays no medical hindrances, physical or mental.  

Diagnosis:  Combat Ready.
menu_sp/vf_file_02_body:
CIA - SR91923000932-LW //  DEFENSE SYSTEM VULNERABILITIES

Methods of Infiltration

We've seen an increasing number of attacks against the Liberty Wall.  The source of the attacks, we believe, are Federation Recon Teams (FEDREC) operating in No Man's Land.

As of now, the attacks have slowed.  However, our own FORCE RECON teams have reported an alarming number of civilian casualties outside the wall.  A detachment recently discovered mass graves in the craters south of Los Angeles. 

We were able to determine that Federation forces are attempting to find alternative ways into the city.
menu_sp/vf_file_03_body:
CIA - SR13727199-G // TIER 1 POWs

Latest reports from OTW Recon show severe breaches in operator safety.  Specific teams that have operated in these areas have proven effective so far, however, at this time, we believe their security has been compromised.

[OPERATOR SAFETY]
We are currently aware of three (3) operators who have gone missing or have been reported K.I.A. near Zones Romeo and Sierra.
Chris Greene    -   "Torch"
Riddian Poe      -   "Grim"
Alex Johnson   -   "Ajax"

Note:  All operators are from the same unit - designation: STALKER
menu_sp/vf_file_04_body:
CIA - SR13727201-G  //  ENEMY POSITIONS OTW

New intel from OTW Recon teams outside the wall show enemy fortifications along the outskirts of San Diego, CA, listed below.

[FIREBASE CHARLIE]
An OTW team has tracked one of our missing POWs to a stadium a half-mile inland of San Diego.  Designated FIREBASE CHARLIE by enemy forces, we believe this to be a Forward Operating Base for the Federation, and a staging ground for launching attacks against the Wall.

Intel suggests the enemy has been transporting POWs to this location and attempting to extract information via interrogation and torture. Due to the high level of security clearance these operators possess, we have issued protocols to ensure our safety.
menu_sp/vf_file_05_body:
CIA - SR0008119192-LW  //  URGENT - IMPENDING ATTACK ON SANTA MONICA

FEDERATION ASSAULT FORCE INBOUND TO FORT SANTA MONICA

Intel has confirmed a large scale enemy force is inbound to Santa Monica and the surrounding areas - including Los Angeles and the Liberty Wall itself. Request immediate deployment of all QRF and Emergency Services.

UPDATE - 5/4 11:23AM
U.S. Forces at Fort Santa Monica have engaged enemy ground troops.  Federation Navy inbound. Attack routes and trajectories hitting GRID 7012 and GRID 3281.

IMMEDIATE ASSISTANCE REQUIRED
menu_sp/vf_file_06_body:
CIA - LB000012995  //  FEDERATION RISE TO POWER

TRANSITION OF POWER AND RESOURCES AFTER TEL AVIV WAR

After multiple conflicts in the Middle East, the invasion of Tel Aviv and the resulting collapse of energy and financial resources in the area resulted in crippling effects to First World countries - mainly those relying on such resources provided by allied governments.

With NATO and Allied Forces spread thin, other governments seized an opportunity to monopolize their own resources and consolidate power over neighboring countries.

Venezuela, Brazil, and Chile unite under one banner, calling themselves "The Federation".  Within the next few years, a massive financial boost to the Federation's economy resulted in a global dominance over energy markets.
menu_sp/vf_file_07_body:
CIA - LB000017955  //  VICTOR RAMOS - PROFILE

Name: Victor H. Ramos
Born: July 1st, ????
Age:  Unknown

Ramos is a high ranking officer in the Federation Science Division, in charge of covert operations outside of San Diego.

Intel suggests he is utilized and protected by the Federation because of his knowledge of reverse engineering classified technology.  Former clients include China, Iran, and North Korea.  His breakthroughs in kinetic energy through projectiles laid the groundwork for the Orbital Defense Initiative (O.D.I.N.) satellite.

He is one of the only people who deals directly with GABRIEL RORKE, and we believe he never stays in the same place more than twenty four hours.
menu_sp/vf_file_08_body:
CIA - SR21945500  //  OPERATION: DEADBOLT

A heavily damaged laptop was recovered from recent operations in Caracas, VZ, but we were able to pull critical data from the HDD.

From what the files suggest, Rorke moves every twenty four hours, much like Victor Ramos - a man in his employ. We are unsure of how many pre-designated locations are used, however we were able to extract a cluster of them from the laptop.

A series of oil platforms and government housing off the coast of the Yucatan Peninsula is the next stop along his route. Called "The Freeport", we believe this area houses small-arms militias loyal to The Federation.  The area is to be considered extremely hostile. The Freeport is our only link to Rorke and we are currently unsure of when his movement cycle will start over.

Recommended COA:  UTILIZATION OF TIER1 TEAMS FOR IMMEDIATE ACTION
menu_sp/vf_file_09_body:
CIA - SR21945616  //  ORDNANCE LAUNCHES IN YUCATAN

Aerial surveillance during OPERATION: DEADBOLT (see CIA - SR21945500) located simultaneous missile-like projectiles launching from the nearby jungle.

Exactly how many projectiles were used is unknown at this time, however allied forces in the area were able to determine at least six (6) of them were successfully launched. Long range tracking lost sight of them within minutes, though the angle of trajectory suggests the ordnance broke into the upper mesosphere.

SAFETY MEASURES FOR U.S. CITIES
Governing bodies of key U.S. cities have been notified, but at this time, the warning is preliminary.  The most current intel we've gathered suggests the projectiles never returned to the stratosphere.
menu_sp/vf_file_10_body:
CIA - SR24100706  //  DAMAGE ESTIMATES 

Below is a report taken from a recent intelligence-gathering operation in Federation occupied Argentina.  These estimates are potential casualties of an attack that, as of yet, has not occurred.

WASHINGTON, D.C.         NEW YORK CITY, NY.
TOTAL: 309,000 est.       TOTAL:  5,681,019 est.

CHICAGO, IL.                     LOS ANGELES, CA.
TOTAL: 1,510,400 est.     TOTAL: 2,773,380 est.

The number of casualties on impact suggest the Federation plans on using nuclear or kinetic-based attacks on U.S. soil, though the latter is pure speculation at this point.
menu_sp/vf_file_11_body:
CIA - AP1-385717 (TS)  // THE SHOP

Intelligence gathered from recent operations in Southern Argentina points to a facility near Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, as a hub for Federation activity.  The significance of this facility, referred to as "The Shop", is unknown, but appears to be of great importance to the enemy.

DIRECT ACTION OPERATIONS
Surveillance rotations have resulted in the loss of one UAV drone that was shot down by anti-aircraft fire.  However, the drone was able to feed topography and enemy defense positions back to us.

The Shop is heavily guarded by a naval fleet on the perimeter of two possible entrances.  Any direct action operations would require immobilization of this fleet. Utilizing STALKER on Atlas Platform proved successful.  The Federation naval fleet was diverted to the wreckage, leaving one AEGIS-CLASS DESTROYER guarding The Shop.
menu_sp/vf_file_12_body:
CIA - RDP921-1 // ADVANCED SYSTEMS OF THE FEDERATION NAVY

Repurposed and reverse engineered U.S. technology has devastated areas where our military was prominent (see 'CIA - RDP921-3'). Current reports indicate an upgraded Arleigh Burke Class (AEGIS) Destroyer being tested somewhere off the coast of Mexico.

The updated sonar-pulse system mimics that of a search sonar found on current AEGIS destroyers active within the U.S. Navy. A report suggests that human subjects (believed to be Federation Soldiers) were used in testing of the device. None were reported to have survived the blasts.

Only one repurposed AEGIS Destroyer has been confirmed. We can safely assume more are in production.
menu_sp/vf_file_13_body:
CIA - IA699614202 (TS)  //  REVERSE ENGINEERED U.S. TECHNOLOGY

Following operations near Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and IA of "The Shop" (CIA - AP1-385717), we have learned of reverse engineering (RE) efforts of the Federation to rebuild and enhance wreckage of the United States Orbital Defense Initiative (ODIN) program.

We believe that Victor RAMOS (see Library File LB000017955) aided the Federation in this effort before being declared K.I.A. in Caracas, VZ earlier this year.

As of June, we have confirmation from eyes on the ground and STALKER that these efforts proved effective.  The Federation is in control of a working prototype of the ODIN satellite, referred to hereafter as "LOKI".  We believe Gabriel T. RORKE is responsible for divulging classified ODIN information to the Federation, allowing them to complete a prototype of LOKI.
menu_sp/vf_file_14_body:
CIA - IA700001892 (TS)  //  COMPROMISED GHOST SAFEHOUSE

Recently a location near Las Vegas, NV used by GHOST was compromised by a former operator in the team, Gabriel RORKE.  In the resulting attack, four operators were taken hostage and one, Elias T. WALKER, was killed in action.

The three remaining operators taken hostage underwent interrogation from RORKE, but we currently do not believe any national security was compromised.  Debrief of the three operators concluded that RORKE's intention was "...vendetta more than [intelligence gathering]".

RORKE was presumed dead during the events of Operation: Return to Sender, but we have since learned he survived and has been working for the Federation, primarily targeting members of GHOST.
menu_sp/vf_file_15_body:
CIA - OA1005382-2 (TS)  //  OPERATION: BLINDSLIDE

ADVISE:  OPERATIONS ARE CURRENTLY UNDERWAY

NORAD has approved an offensive strike against a satellite array (SATFARM) in the Atacama Desert of Chile.  The SATFARM is communicating with the Federation controlled satellite (CIA-IA699614202) in an attempt to coordinate kinetic strikes against the United States.

At this time, mobilization of forces is already underway at Fort Santa Monica.  Additional coordination with SOCOM and utilization of GHOST requested.  However, due to recent flaws of operational security assets, it is unknown if they can be of assistance.
menu_sp/vf_file_16_body:
CIA - OA1005382-3 (TS)  //  OPERATION: BLINDSLIDE

LOKI / SATFARM CONNECTION
The SATFARM communicates with FEDSAT to direct attacks, however the satellite is still capable of kinetic bombardment of areas without any assistance.  These attacks would deal catastrophic damage to targets, but without SATFARM's involvement, FEDSAT is firing blind.

CONTINGENCY OPERATIONS
A decommissioned space shuttle has been repurposed for a direct action mission aimed directly at FEDSAT.  NORAD currently has an assault team standing by for tasking, should the SATFARM operation prove successful.  With SATFARM disabled, FEDSAT will be vulnerable to attack, allowing us to put strike teams onboard the station itself.
menu_sp/vf_file_17_body:
CIA - OA1005382-4 (TS)  // ENHANCEMENTS OVER ODIN

Further developments from intel recovered from The Shop (see CIA-AP1-385717) show that the Federation Satellite (FEDSAT) is an upgraded, more streamlined enhancement of the original ODIN prototype.

Enhancements from intelligence gathered at The Shop described below:
- Tungsten rod variations
The U.S. operated ODIN used only 6.1 x 0.3m tungsten cylinders as projectiles. FEDSAT is using various sized rods not exceeding those of ODIN.  This allows for impacts closer to allied forces without the fear of danger close fire.

- Necklace configuration
FEDSAT is using subsidiary firing platforms controlled by a central HUB satellite.  These platforms allow for a greater range of potential targets. Current intel suggests the United States and Allied European countries are at the highest risk.
menu_sp/vf_file_18_body:
I am Gabriel Rorke.

I have been trained by your Government to be a weapon.  Trained to kill and destroy.  All in the name of Liberty and Justice.  Even surrender my very life in service to your country.

But I am not one of you. The "Just" have turned their backs and become deaf to your cries.  Who, then, will show them justice?  Who will show you the Liberty they have promised?  The weapon they have created will be their undoing.

But do not fear this.  Do not fear me.  It is only natural.  Like the collapse of Rome, your cities will crumble and there will be great sorrow.  But from the ashes of this diseased metropolis, a rebirth will occur.  It will be paid for with blood and steel. Liberty must be restored. I am Gabriel Rorke, and I am here to show you the true meaning of justice.
menu_sp/vf_file_19_body:
Age: 51
Rank: Captain, RET.
Birthplace: San Diego, CA
Callsign: Scarecrow

Captain Walker is the acting commander of GHOST, and is also one of its oldest operators.  A career soldier, his 30+ years of service have been invaluable to the safety of the United States.

His two sons, Logan and David "Hesh" Walker, are also active duty operators - performing S&R/Recon outside the wall.

Captain Walker has been nominated for the Congressional Medal of Honor, multiple Silver and Bronze stars, but has declined to receive any, preferring anonymity.
menu_sp/vf_file_20_body:
Age: 28
Rank: Lieutenant
Birthplace: San Diego, CA

David Walker ("HESH") is the oldest son of Captain Elias T. Walker, RET.  His brother, Logan Walker, also serves in the same Outside the Wall (OTW) Recon team.

Lt. Walker has received numerous commendations for operations near the border zone, referred to as No Man's Land.  His superiors have called him a "...natural born leader."

At this time, he is being considered as a top tier candidate for Task Force: STALKER.
menu_sp/vf_file_21_body:
Age: 41
Rank: Captain
Birthplace: Sacramento, CA

Thomas A. Merrick ("MERRICK") joined the United States Navy at age 17, and quickly became one of the youngest recruits to ever complete SEAL training. He was later assigned to SEAL Team Two, deploying to the Middle East.

He was one of fifteen survivors of an operation near the Iran border. He was later assigned to Task Force STALKER (GHOST), where he currently resides as team leader in the field.

Merrick is the third generation of his family to serve with the U.S. Military.  His grandfather, Clyde E. Merrick, was killed in Normandy during Operation Neptune. His father, SSgt. Nicholas "Bull" Merrick, was killed in Fallujah.

onboarding/armored_royale_desc_3: In Armored Royale, the Gas Circle shrinks and moves quickly. Stay with your truck and use it to outrun the gas!

onboarding/blueprint_store_ch2wz_2: Any Blueprints that you acquire can be applied directly to your Loadouts or taken into the Gunsmith for modification.

onboarding/career_laze_newcareer_2: Unlock weapons from Vanguard, Black Ops Cold War and Modern Warfare.
onboarding/career_laze_newcareer_3: Complete your Military Ranks and begin or continue the Prestige Journey you began in Vanguard's pre-season with the launch of Season 1.
onboarding/career_leasonleveling_1: Progress your Season and Prestige Levels wherever you play, with unified progression across Warzone, Black Ops Cold War, and Modern Warfare. Can you reach Prestige Master?
onboarding/career_leasonleveling_2: Reach Season Level milestones to gain access to Seasonal Calling Card Challenges.
onboarding/career_leasonleveling_3:

Season Level resets at the end of each Season, but you will keep your earned Prestige Level.

onboarding/cdl_rules_1: Play like the pros while still earning XP, unlocking content, and completing challenges!
onboarding/cdl_rules_2: Play Call of Duty League™ Maps and Game Modes with League approved ruleset.
onboarding/cdl_rules_3: In the Call of Duty League™ playlists, your Private Match Loadouts are used and all items are unlocked. Restricted items will be replaced.

Equip weapons from all 3 titles in your Warzone Loadout.
onboarding/challenges_ch2wz_reserves_1: New Daily Challenges are added to the Reserves. Swap Challenges in and out to suit your play style and optimize your progression.
onboarding/challenges_ch2wz_reserves_2: Active Challenges that are swapped into the reserves will retain their progress until you come back to them later.
onboarding/challenges_daily_ch2wz_1:
Receive a set of 3 new Daily Challenges every day. 
Warzone Daily Challenge categories include Reconnaissance, Combat and Support.
onboarding/classified_challenges_desc:
Grind for the ultimate bragging rights in Call of Duty history. Complete all ^5282 ^7weapon master challenges for all ^547 ^7 weapons in the game and be awarded this one-of-a-kind calling card.

Note: Kill and Headshot challenges count as one classified challenge progress.
onboarding/cw_ch2_operators_1: Operators in Warzone are no longer separated by their faction.
onboarding/dbd_hint_text_1: Health is increased. Regen speed reduced while timer is increased.
onboarding/dbd_hint_text_2: Altered rarities, attachment rules, and Buy Station prices.
onboarding/dbd_hint_text_3: Claim victory in Iron Trials for ultimate bragging rights for you and your squad
onboarding/editdropkit_1: Edit Loadout allows you to configure loadouts that can be accessed during the match. Assemble battle-ready combinations of Weapons, Equipment, and Perks.
onboarding/editdropkit_2: Primary and Secondary weapons form the base of your loadout. Perks give your soldier abilities on the battlefield.
onboarding/editdropkit_3: You may create and name multiple loadouts for various gameplay situations. Be sure to experiment with new combinations as you level up and unlock new functionalities.
onboarding/editdropkit_mw_editloadout_1: Edit Loadout allows you to configure loadouts that can be accessed during the match. Assemble battle-ready combinations of Weapons, Equipment and Perks.
onboarding/editdropkit_mw_editloadout_2: Primary and Secondary weapons form the base of your loadout. Perks give your soldier abilities on the battlefield.
onboarding/editdropkit_mw_editloadout_3: You may create and name multiple loadouts for various gameplay situations. Be sure to experiment with new combinations as you level.
onboarding/editdropkit_wz_editloadout_2: Perks provide passive benefits on the battlefield, and Field Upgrades allow you to call in support mid-match. Primary and Secondary Weapons from Vanguard, Black Ops and Modern Warfare form the base of your loadout.
onboarding/editdropkit_wz_editloadout_3: Create and name multiple classes for various gameplay situations. Be sure to experiment with new combinations as you level up and unlock new gear and functionality.
onboarding/elder_1: Officer Ranks are a new seasonal leveling system for Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare®. Once you have completed the Enlisted Ranks, you may climb the Officer Ranks to earn recognition and rewards.
onboarding/elder_2: Each new Officer Rank unlocks a challenge which can be completed for a medal ribbon and an XP boost. The more Rank Challenges you complete, the more ribbons you earn and the faster you progress.
onboarding/elder_3: Officer Ranks are specific to the current Season. Climb as high as possible during the current season to maximize your Rank. Remember - Officer Ranks are reset at the start of each new Season, but your achievements will be saved to build your history as a combatant.
onboarding/exfil_hint_header_3: Hold On to the Radio to Exfil
onboarding/exfil_hint_text_1: Drop in with your squad and gear up for combat. Gather weapons, ammo, and armor.
onboarding/exfil_hint_text_2: Grabbing the radio grants your team redeployment and intel, but reveals your location.
onboarding/exfil_hint_text_3: Protect the radio at all costs. When time expires, the team holding the radio exfils successfully.
onboarding/fieldupgrade_1: Field Upgrades are abilities and pieces of gear that can give you a tactical edge in battle.
onboarding/fieldupgrade_2: They recharge throughout a fight. More powerful Field Upgrades take longer to charge.
onboarding/fieldupgrade_3: Field Upgrade Pro lets you equip two Field Upgrades instead of one. Choose between them on each activation. Unlocked at level 45.
onboarding/fieldupgrade_pro_desc: Field upgrade pro is now available. You can now equip 2 field upgrades instead of 1. Choose between them on each activation.
onboarding/gamebattles_1: Grab your teammates and head over to GameBattles.com to participate in upcoming GameBattles ladders, tournaments, and Call of Duty Challengers competitions.
onboarding/gamebattles_2: Play your match in the GameBattles menu in Modern Warfare® and your results will automatically be reported to GameBattles.
onboarding/gamebattles_3: The use of GameBattles is subject to the Major League Gaming Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and other applicable rules. Visit GameBattles.com for more information.

Set up Two-Factor Authentication to protect your account and enable Gifting. Earn two 1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Tokens for signing up!

Battle Pass and Store Bundles can now be Gifted to Friends!

Your Friend will receive a notification in-game letting them know that you've sent them a Gift! They will have access to the Gifted items immediately.

onboarding/group_desc_1: Your last Active Regiment has been upgraded to a Clan and is currently accessible in Vanguard.
onboarding/group_desc_2:
Your other Regiment rosters didn't disappear!
All of your regiment rosters have been converted to Groups.
onboarding/group_desc_3:
You can be the leader of more than one Group!
Become a member or lead up to 10 Groups in Warzone.
onboarding/group_laze_desc_3:
You can be the leader of more than one Group!
Become a member or lead up to 10 Groups.
onboarding/gunfight_3: Or, first team to reach score limit wins
onboarding/gunsmith_1: Gunsmith is a deep weapon customization system that allows you to create your own custom firearms.
onboarding/gunsmith_2: Leveling up your weapons in battle will unlock new attachments across 8 attachment zones, as well as weapon perks.
onboarding/gunsmith_2_ch2_wz: Unlock new attachment zones by leveling up your weapons during battle across Vanguard, Black Ops, Modern Warfare and Warzone.
onboarding/gunsmith_3: Upgrade your weapon with up to 5 attachments that significantly change how your weapon feels. Experiment with various combinations to suit your playstyle and different game modes.
onboarding/gunsmith_3_wz_only: Upgrade your Vanguard weapons with up to 10 attachments that significantly change how your weapon feels. Experiment with various combinations to suit your playstyle and different game modes.
onboarding/gunsmith_customs_1: When selecting attachments, hit the Blueprint button to select from the attachment variants you own!
onboarding/gunsmith_customs_2: Combine cosmetic attachment variants from other weapons to create the weapon that's right for you!
onboarding/killstreak_1: Killstreaks are powerful support packages that you can call into the battlefield during a match. Used properly, they can turn the tide of a fight.
onboarding/killstreak_2: Earn Killstreaks by getting Kills without dying. Each type of Killstreak requires a specific number of Kills to earn. The more Kills one costs, the more powerful it is. You may choose three Killstreaks as part of your combat readiness.
onboarding/killstreak_3: When you're in combat, you may trigger each Killstreak once you've achieved the corresponding number of Kills. Be sure to keep an eye on the Killstreak HUD to see what you have available.
onboarding/kingslayer_hint_text_1: Fast paced, multi-team combat within a moving gas circle.
onboarding/kingslayer_hint_text_2: Open Supply Boxes and Care Packages to gain Killstreaks for a competitive edge!
onboarding/kingslayer_hint_text_3: Downing kill leaders rewards extra score and a random Killstreak. First team to the score limit wins!
onboarding/lfp_desc_1: Configure your settings the way you want to play. Choose from Game Modes, Play Style and Communication preferences.
onboarding/lfp_desc_2: Find players with similar interests to party up with.
onboarding/lfp_desc_3: Play together as a team. Keep playing as a party across matches.
onboarding/lfp_title_2: Step 2: Start looking for a party
onboarding/loadout_1: Edit loadout allows you to configure your own battle-ready combinations of Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Killstreaks, and Field Upgrades.
onboarding/loadout_1_cp: Create A Class allows you to configure your own battle-ready combinations of Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Munitions, and Roles.
onboarding/loadout_2: Primary and Secondary weapons form the base of your loadout. Perks give your soldier special abilities on the battlefield, while Killstreaks and Field Upgrades allow you to call in support mid-match.
onboarding/loadout_2_cp: Primary and Secondary weapons form the base of your class. Perks give your soldier special abilities on the battlefield, while Munitions and Roles allow you provide support to your team.
onboarding/loadout_3: You may create and name multiple loadouts for various gameplay situations. Be sure to experiment with new combinations as you level up and unlock new functionality. You can set your favorite loadout to see it on the gun bench and in the hands of your Operator in the menus.
onboarding/master_challenges_1: Work your way through different skill-based challenges to unlock unique mastery calling cards.
onboarding/mature_content_desc: Player discretion is advised. Some scenes include graphic or intense content including violence. Please consult the game’s ratings.
onboarding/milsim_1:
Represent your country with new Mil-Sim operators for both Coalition and Allegiance factions. Mil-Sim Operators can be purchased in
bundles from the ^$Store ^7or unlocked via the ^$Battle Pass^7.
onboarding/mission_challenges_1: Missions are multi-step challenges that can be completed for XP bonuses and special rewards.
onboarding/mission_challenges_2: Missions must be activated in order to complete them. Activate a Mission from the Missions page and track your progress. You will be notified when you complete each step and when you have completed your overall objectives.
onboarding/mission_challenges_3: There are several Missions available, with more to be released in each new season. Be sure to check back to the Missions page for new challenges and rewards.
onboarding/mod_1: Custom Mods are weapons that you create, customize, and save into your Armory. Mod slots are unlocked by leveling each weapon.
onboarding/mod_2: Create a Custom Mod in Gunsmith by adding attachments, customizing with camos and charms, and then saving it into one of your Mod Slots. You can personalize its name to make it stand out.
onboarding/mod_3: Custom Mods track stats, so your weapon will build a history. As long as your Mod retains the same base weapon and name, you may continue to modify it.
onboarding/moshpit_trials_1: For a limited time, hop into Modern Warfare's multiplayer mode to rank up, level your guns and complete challenges.
onboarding/moshpit_trials_2: A wide variety of Maps and Game-modes are live in the Multiplayer Trial playlist.
onboarding/moshpit_trials_3: If you upgrade you can choose what you want to play, when you want to play it. A deep and mature Campaign, a fun action Packed 4 Player Co-Op Experience and a Variety filled Multiplayer complete with 2v2 Gunfight, Night Vision, Realism, Objective Modes, 64 Player Ground War battles and much much more!
onboarding/munition_1: Munitions can be equipped before going in game by spending points won by playing the game.
onboarding/munition_2: Munitions found during a mission are not kept afterwards.
onboarding/munition_3: Activate munitions using the radial menu. Points will be spent when they are used.

Season 1. Progress your Military Rank and unlock Vanguard items while playing all 4 Call of Duty titles.
You will be able to progress your Military Rank and Season Level across Warzone, Vanguard, Black Ops Cold War, and Modern Warfare.
Warzone, Vanguard, Black Ops Cold War, and Modern Warfare will share the Battle Pass. Purchase anywhere and unlock tiers by playing any of these titles. Items can be equipped in Vanguard or Warzone.
onboarding/onboarding_text_rebirth_1: Survive during the Resurgence countdown to redeploy your allies to the Warzone. Earn points to shorten the countdown
onboarding/onboarding_text_rebirth_2: Heads up! Resurgence supply boxes can be re-opened shortly after use.
onboarding/onboarding_text_rebirth_3: Getting a kill highlights the victim's allies positions for a brief period in your mini-map.
onboarding/operator_1: Operators are soldiers of the Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® universe. Each one has their own personality and look on the battlefield.
onboarding/operator_2: Operators are divided into two Factions—Coalition and Allegiance. Choose a favorite Operator from each side to take into combat.
onboarding/operator_3: You may customize your Operators to give them additional flair. Outfit them with new Skins, change their VO Quips, or select their Finishing Moves from the "Customize Operator" menu.
onboarding/operator_3_wz:
You may customize your operators with new skins, change
their VO Quips, or select their finishing moves to give them
additional flair. Operators and cosmetics can be purchased in
bundles from the ^$Store ^7or unlocked via the ^$Battle Pass^7.
onboarding/operator_missions_1: Operator Missions have been moved from the Missions screen to the Operators screen.
onboarding/operator_missions_2: You no longer need to manually select Operator Missions – if an Operator has an available Mission, it will be active automatically when you have that Operator selected.
onboarding/operator_missions_3: Core Missions are still available to select from the Missions screen. Make sure to complete your Missions and maximize your XP.
onboarding/operator_missions_ch2wz_1:
Vanguard Operators have a new ^$Progression System.^7
Completing Operator missions will help you to level up faster and unlock new skins.
onboarding/operator_missions_ch2wz_2: Each Vanguard Operator has a ^$Favorite Weapon^7 that can be found in their bio. Equip them together to receive bonus XP while you play.
onboarding/operators_ch2wz_only_1: Operators are the soldiers of the Call of Duty universe. Each has their own personality and look on the battlefield.
onboarding/operators_ch2wz_only_2: Acquire Operator Skins by purchasing store bundles or via the Battle Pass.
onboarding/operators_ch2wz_only_3: Customize your Operators’ Skins and Finishing Moves to give them additional flair and suit your style.
onboarding/perk_1:
Perks are passive bonuses that can be mixed and matched to fit your playstyle. 
Use them to boost your strengths or cover your weaknesses.
onboarding/perk_2: Enable Specialist for a loadout to earn perks instead of killstreaks. After 8 kills, become the ultimate soldier. Unlocked at level 29.
onboarding/perk_3:
Retrieving a loadout from your Dropkit will equip your Perks. 
Plan ahead and choose perks that will give you an edge in Warzone.
onboarding/perk_update_1: Perks have been adjusted to help create more balanced choices. Weak and unpopular perks have been buffed! Read the notes in the perk descriptions to find out more about what has changed for each perk.
onboarding/perk_update_2: ^5Overkill ^7is now a red slot perk and must be picked against some of the strongest perks in the game. Combine it with scavenger to keep yourself fully loaded for any situation.
onboarding/perk_update_3: ^5Kill Chain ^7has been moved to the blue slot. Combine it with Hardline or Pointman for a super charged killstreak loadout.
onboarding/plunder_hint_text_1: Loot, complete Contracts and take cash from rival players.
onboarding/plunder_hint_text_2: Deposit cash at cash deposit points and with portable deposit balloons. Deposited cash is safe and cannot be stolen.
onboarding/plunder_hint_text_3: Cash leaders' locations are shown on the map.
onboarding/plunder_intro_popup_desc_1: Learn the mechanics of the Plunder gamemode to gain an edge on your opponent - and earn a unique reward!
onboarding/prestige_master_progression_1: Every season, a new Prestige Master Ribbon will be unlocked
onboarding/prestige_master_progression_2: Complete ^$200^7 Season Levels and earn ^$1^7 Prestige Master Ribbon.
onboarding/prestige_master_progression_3: Catch up, and earn all Prestige Master Ribbons from past seasons. Season Levels max out at ^$1000^7.
onboarding/prestige_progression_1: New Prestige Levels will be added to your Prestige Journey with the start of every season.
onboarding/prestige_progression_2: Complete ^$50^7 Season Levels and earn ^$1^7 Prestige Level.
onboarding/prestige_progression_3:
Catch up on your Prestige Levels! 
Players can earn up to ^$1000^7 Season Levels in a single season.
onboarding/rebirth_hint_text_1: Heads up! Resurgence supply boxes can be re-opened shortly after use.
onboarding/rebirth_hint_text_2: Survive during the Resurgence countdown to redeploy your allies to the Warzone. Earn points to shorten the countdown
onboarding/rebirth_hint_text_3: Be the last team alive to win. Eliminate opponents and escape the gas.
onboarding/regiment_1: Welcome to your new regiment! Access your regiment's roster, squad up with other players, view the next Happy Hour, or even join another regiment.
onboarding/regiment_2: Check back regularly to squad up with your regiment and take advantage of Happy Hour for Double XP.
onboarding/regiment_3: Represent your regiment with gold clan tags! Get your golden clan tag by matching your clan tag with your regiment's.
onboarding/regiment_freeze_desc_1: Regiments are migrating to a new in game community system with expanded benefits for players!
onboarding/regiment_freeze_desc_2: Transition to the new system will be automated based on your current active regiment.
onboarding/regiment_freeze_desc_3: Regiment rosters have been temporarily switched to read-only maintenance mode until release of this update is completed later this year.
onboarding/reveal_hint_text_1: This is our final mission in Verdansk
onboarding/reveal_hint_text_2: Lets send those freakbags back into the ground!
onboarding/reveal_hint_text_3: The only way out is to survive long enough
onboarding/risk_hint_text_1: 10 plates spawn at once. Capture plates to spawn an Intel Token. New plate locations spawn at intervals.
onboarding/risk_hint_text_2: Collect and hold 10 Intel Tokens to win. Spread tokens among teammates to avoid losing them all at once.
onboarding/risk_hint_text_3: Check the Tac Map to find players with high Token counts and steal them.
onboarding/role_1: A Role is defined by the combination of an activated ability and a passive ability.
onboarding/role_2: Choose a Role for your desired play style.
onboarding/role_3: A team with players in different Roles is equipped to handle any situation.
onboarding/rumble_hint_text_1: Battle inside areas around Caldera, the first team to reach the score limit wins!
onboarding/rumble_hint_text_2: Eliminate enemy players, complete contracts, and participate in public events to earn points for your team.
onboarding/rumble_hint_text_3: Unlock buffs by collecting powerups that can spawn from loot caches or eliminated players.
onboarding/season_event_hint_desc_01:
Decorate the marked Holiday Trees.
The longer you hold, the better the loot.
onboarding/season_event_hint_desc_02:
Krampus hunts the Naughty! 
Defeat him for a one-of-a-kind calling card.
onboarding/season_event_hint_desc_03:
Destroy the Elves.
Listen for their laughter. 
Don't get close!
onboarding/specialist_desc: At level 29 the specialist mode becomes available. When activated you can have up to 6 perks in your loadout. You earn an extra perk every 2 kills. After 8 kills you earn the Specialist bonus which grants most perks and weapon perks in the game.
onboarding/specialist_warning: *Killstreaks are disabled when this mode is active
onboarding/sprays_desc_1: Equip and preview both gestures and sprays here in the Barracks tab.
onboarding/sprays_desc_2: Press and hold [{ONFOOT:+actionslot 1}] to bring up the Gestures & Sprays menu in-game.
onboarding/sprays_desc_2_kbm: Press and hold [{ONFOOT_MP:gesture_wheel}] to bring up the Gestures & Sprays menu in-game.
onboarding/sprays_desc_3: Use [{ui_right_stick}] to highlight a gesture or spray then release [{ONFOOT:+actionslot 1}] to use it.
onboarding/sprays_desc_3_kbm: Highlight a gesture or spray then release [{ONFOOT_MP:gesture_wheel}] to use it.
onboarding/tdm_1: Allows parties of up to 6 players each
onboarding/tdm_3: Be the first team to the score limit OR highest score when the clock runs out
onboarding/tdm_anywhere_desc_1: Large-scale Team Deathmatch in areas around Verdansk.
onboarding/tdm_anywhere_desc_2: Eliminate the enemy team. If you get eliminated, don't worry! You will respawn and parachute back into the Warzone.
onboarding/tdm_anywhere_desc_3: Kill players on the opposing team. The first team to reach the score limit wins!
onboarding/trial_event_desc_1: Compete in the current Trial and try to score bronze, silver, and gold medals. This event's Trials do not cost you tickets to play.
onboarding/trial_event_desc_3: Unlock all five gold medals to earn a unique reward.
onboarding/tutorial_plunder_1_header: Team With the Most Cash Wins
onboarding/tutorial_plunder_1_point_1: Players with the most cash are marked
onboarding/tutorial_plunder_2_desc: Get cash by finding loot crates, completing contracts or killing other players to steal their cash.
onboarding/tutorial_plunder_3_desc: Protect your cash by depositing it during the match. This prevents that cash from being stolen if you are killed.
onboarding/tutorial_plunder_3_header: Deposit Cash to Keep it Safe
onboarding/vehicle_camos_2: Vehicle Skins will appear when you're the first to enter a vehicle.
onboarding/vehicle_camos_3:
When available, Vehicle Skins can be purchased in
bundles from the ^$Store ^7or unlocked via the ^$Battle Pass^7.
onboarding/vehicle_horn_desc_1: Unlock Vehicle Horns by earning them in the Battle Pass or purchasing them in the Store.
onboarding/vehicle_horn_desc_2: Equip them in the Horns menu within the Vehicle Customization option in the Weapons tab.
onboarding/vehicle_horn_desc_3: Hop into your vehicle and get the attention you deserve.
onboarding/vg_hint_text_1: Equip yourself with weaponry suited for battle in the heart of the Pacific during 1944.
onboarding/vg_hint_text_2: Get airborne to dogfight or to be a spotter for your squad, but watch for the Anti-Air Cannons.
onboarding/vg_hint_text_3: Complete new Contracts and engage in the new Public Events, both for increased rewards.
onboarding/vov_hint_text_1: Drop in with your squad to find unique loot and prepare for combat. Loadout drops are not guaranteed.
onboarding/vov_hint_text_1b: Circles are accelerated. Crates contain unique loot.
onboarding/vov_hint_text_1c: Every new circle starts a random event, prepare for flashbacks from the past.
onboarding/vov_hint_text_2: Every circle starts an event, some may be familiar. Prepare to face unexpected challenges.
onboarding/vov_hint_text_2c: Contracts and Supply Boxes reward memories of yesterday, with a chance of Powerups or Keycards.
onboarding/vov_hint_text_3: Buy Station options are changed. Special armaments are available.
onboarding/vov_hint_text_3c: New items are in stock. Loadout Markers can be purchased after the Loadout Event.
onboarding/warzone_private_match_desc_1: Grab friends and run your own private Warzone matches.
onboarding/warzone_private_match_desc_2: Choose between the various Warzone modes including Battle Royale and Plunder.
onboarding/warzone_private_match_desc_3: Ability to join up on different squads, team up with new players, or jump in with friends you already know.
onboarding/weapon_customization_1: Unlock Camos, Reticles, Charms and Stickers by completing weapon challenges during combat across Vanguard, Black Ops Cold War, Modern Warfare and Warzone.
onboarding/weapon_mastery_1: The new obsidian camo is now available on all weapons. Unlock the camo by completing the obsidian challenge for each weapon.
onboarding/weapon_mastery_1_ch2wz: Master each Modern Warfare weapon and unlock exclusive rewards by completing various challenge types. Weapon mastery challenges become available after obtaining a weapon's gold camo.
onboarding/weapon_mastery_2: Master each weapon and unlock exclusive rewards by completing various challenge types. Weapon mastery challenges become available after obtaining a weapon's gold camo.
onboarding/weapon_mastery_2_ch2wz: Progress Weapon Mastery and Class Mastery Challenges across Black Ops Cold War and Warzone to earn Camos, Calling Cards, and other rewards. Do you have what it takes to earn Dark Matter?
onboarding/wz_congratulation_popup_desc_: Congratulations on completing the Warzone training. Replay it anytime by accessing it from the play menu.
Now team up and jump into the real fight and be the last soldier standing in Warzone.
Don’t forget to set up your Loadout Drop before the match to pick up your best equipment in the Warzone.
onboarding/wz_intro_popup_desc_1:
Join a squad to jump into large scale combat in Battle Royale and Plunder in Warzone.
Available every season.
onboarding/wz_intro_popup_desc_1_alt: Join a squad to jump into large scale combat in Battle Royale and Plunder in Warzone. Play training now or later to earn exclusive rewards.
onboarding/wz_intro_popup_desc_3: Fun, Limited Mode available every season.
onboarding/wz_magmaplayers_congratulatio: Congratulations on completing the Warzone training. Replay it anytime.

perks/sn_crossbow: Silent and agile, this high-performance crossbow fires 20.0" bolts with exceptional lethality.  Exclusive customization, distinct functionality, and unique ammunition types put this weapon in a class of its own.  Standard 20.0" bolts are recoverable, and are undetectable by trophy systems.
perks/sn_delta: A soviet workhorse chambered in 7.62mm x 54mmR.  This gas-operated, semi-automatic sniper rifle allows for rapid follow-up shots.
perks/sn_hdromeo: An anti-material bolt action sniper rifle chambered in 12.7x108mm ammunition.  745 gr bullets have a lower muzzle velocity, but are devastating at very long ranges.
perks/sn_india: Bolt action .308 scout rifle. Exceptionally light and stable, headshot lethal.
perks/sn_kilo98: Bolt action rifle chambered in 7.92 Mauser.  A WW2 relic that is still extremely lethal in the hands of a rebel marksman.
perks/sn_mike14: A semi-automatic long range marksman rifle balances rate of fire with lethality.
perks/sn_romeo700: Reliable, hard-hitting .300 Win bolt action rifle from Sloan Precision.  This weapon's extensive military and civilian use gives rise to an abundance of customization.
perks/sn_sbeta: Highly accurate lever action rifle.  Will neutralize an enemy with one well placed round to the head or chest.
perks/sn_sksierra: Lightweight, semi-auto Carbine chambered in 7.62x39mm.  This hard hitting and agile Soviet rifle focuses on utility over accuracy.  It flaunts a faster fire rate than other weapons in its class, but a carefully placed round will eliminate the need for follow up shots entirely.  This classic DMR has seen a lot of battles, and its unique gunsmith configurations reflect a diverse service history.
perks/sn_t9crossbow: Launches lethal bolt projectiles to silently eliminate enemies. Excellent hip fire accuracy with good handling. Bolts must be manually loaded.
perks/sn_xmike109: This semi-automatic Anti-Material Rifle is chambered in .50 BMG for dominant long range assaults.  A 25x59mm high-explosive payload variant is officially listed as "experimental", but has been deployed on multiple classified missions with great effectiveness.
perks/sniper_cheytac: 2-round burst bolt-action ballistic rifle.  Features a unique ^5chamber stack^7 for predictable two round burst fire and a ^5lightweight mold^7 for increased mobility.
perks/sniper_cheytac_classic: Bolt-action ballistic rifle.  Renowned for superior stability, handling, and unforgiving recoil.
perks/sniper_g28: Semi-automatic. A built-in ^5Foregrip^7 lowers recoil. Shorter range with highest rate of fire in its class.
perks/sniper_gm6: Semi-automatic. Lower mobility, deadly from the knee up through center mass.
perks/sniper_kbs: Bolt-action ballistic rifle.  One shot, one kill from the waist up.  Rechambering breaks scope aim.
perks/sniper_l115a3:
Bolt-action. Deadly from the knee up through center mass.
^5Recoil Compensator^7 reduces kick with each kill.
perks/sniper_m8: Semi-auto energy rifle.  Hold ^5[{toggleweapalt,+weapnext}]^7 to activate ^5assault rifle mode^7 for automatic fire and reduced power consumption.
perks/sniper_m8_charge: Charged 3-Round burst energy rifle. Hold ^5[{toggleweapalt,+weapnext}]^7 to activate ^5assault rifle mode^7 for automatic fire and reduced power consumption.
perks/sniper_mk14: Semi-automatic. Moderate recoil, highest damage per round in its class.
perks/sniper_svu: Semi-automatic. Effective at long range with moderate recoil.
perks/sniper_usr: Bolt-action. Deadly from the waist up with faster handling.
perks/sniper_vks: Semi-automatic. Integrated ^5Silencer^7 with highest ammo capacity and rate of fire in its class.
perks/sp_atomizer_desc: Experimental energy based handgun that blasts victims into a cloud of mist. (No ammo crate refills)
perks/sp_beam_steeldragon: Powerful energy beam with auto tracking. (No ammo crate refills)
perks/sp_launcher_chargeshot_desc: Charge up plasma launcher with extreme splash damage. (No ammo crate refills)
perks/sp_launcher_lockon_desc: Anti-air launcher. Supports straight dumb fire and locking-on to air targets. (No ammo crate refills)
perks/sp_penetrator_desc: Highly accurate electromagnetic projectile launcher with increased penetration capability. (No ammo crate refills)
perks/specialist_patch_notes:
^2+ More score is earned for assists.
+ More score is earned for objective play.
+ Earn score by helping teammates destroy killstreaks.
perks/spotter_desc: See outlines on enemy equipment, and mark enemy soldiers for your team while in ADS
perks/sprintfire_desc: Shoot, use equipment and scorestreaks while sprinting.
perks/stealth_desc:
Invisible to UAV
Your nameplate doesn't appear for enemies
perks/strategist_br_desc: All members of your team earn more money from completed missions.
perks/strategist_desc:
Killstreaks are earned through game score instead of number of kills.
^2Specialist Only:^7 Earn perks instead of killstreaks.
perks/strategist_desc_extra:
- Counter UAVs and UAVs only give 100 score max per use.
- Advanced UAVs and White Phosphorus only give 150 score max per use.
perks/super_blackholegun_desc: Fires a projectile that distorts gravity, sucking in enemies and exploding on impact.
perks/super_pack_desc: Kills drop Payload cooldown packs for your team.
perks/surveillance_desc: Your vision pulses when enemies outside of your view see you.
perks/surveillance_desc_extra: - Triggered by enemies controlling Chopper Gunners, Wheelsons, IAVs, and APCs.
perks/survivor_desc: Blast Shield with resistance to explosive damage
perks/tac_mask_desc: Maximized resistance to stun effects. Immune to gas.
perks/tac_resist_desc: Reduce strength of enemy flash, stun, EMP, and gas effects. Immune to snapshot grenades.
perks/tac_resist_patch_notes:
^2+ Added gas resistance.
+ Added Snapshot Grenade immunity.
perks/tactical_recon_desc: Detect enemy equipment, field upgrades, and killstreaks through walls. Mark them for your team by aiming down sights. Hack enemy equipment and field upgrades.
perks/tactician_desc: Restock your tactical equipment every 30 seconds.
perks/tank_desc:
-Take an additional hit to the head before going down.

^5Pro:^7 
-^3Field Upgrade:^7 trophy system.
-Take an additional hit to the chest before going down.
perks/tele_slide_desc: Teleport a short distance instead of slide.
perks/throwing_axe_desc: An ancient ceremonial axe used primarily for executions.  Can be thrown by using [{+speed_throw}].
perks/tune_up_br_desc:
Reduce the charge time of field upgrades by 40%. 
Reduce revive time by 25%.
perks/tune_up_desc: Reduces the charge time of field upgrades by 40%.
perks/unlocked_at_lv21: Unlocked at Sergeant First Class I (Lv21).
perks/unlocked_at_lv22: Unlocked at Sergeant First Class II (Lv22).
perks/unlocked_at_lv23: Unlocked at Sergeant First Class III (Lv23).
perks/unlocked_at_lv37: Unlocked at Command Sergeant Major I (Lv37).
perks/unlocked_at_lv38: Unlocked at Command Sergeant Major II (Lv38).
perks/unlocked_at_lv39: Unlocked at Command Sergeant Major III (Lv39).
perks/unlocked_at_lv5: Unlocked at Private First Class I (Lv5).
perks/unlocked_at_lv6: Unlocked at Private First Class II (Lv6).
perks/upgrade_assassin: No red crosshair or name when targeted.
perks/upgrade_blindeye: +Launchers lock-on quicker. Extra bullet damage versus air support and sentries.
perks/upgrade_hardline: Every two assists counts as a kill towards your killstreak.
perks/upgrade_holdbreath: Hold breath for longer while aiming down sights
perks/upgrade_menu_blocked: Must be on ground to upgrade perks.
perks/upgrade_paint: +Bullet damage paints the target on the minimap.
perks/upgrade_quickdraw: +Recover from equipment and grenade usage quicker.
perks/wall_lock_desc: Lock to a wallrunning surface for a short time when going into ADS.  Length of time is determined by how much of the boost meter is left.
perks/warhead_desc: Faster weapon swap and rocket launcher reload speed.
perks/warhead_desc_extra:
- Does not affect swapping to pistols and knives.
- Most equipment is used faster.
perks/you_will_now_be_camouflaged_when: You will now be camouflaged when sniping in urban environments.
perks_baker/br_covert_ops_desc: Undetectable by AI targeting systems and thermal optics. Does not trigger High Alert warning and negates Combat Scout.
perks_baker/desc_advancedscout: Damaging an enemy briefly highlights them for you and marks them for the entire squad.
perks_baker/desc_reinforced: Refill armor plates to full with two plates instead of three. Equipping this perk fully restores armor.
perks_baker/surveillance_desc: Your vision pulses when enemies outside of your view see you. Footsteps from players using Dead Silence are audible.
perks_tango/ar_t9accurate: Full-auto assault rifle.  Improved damage and accuracy.  Excellent weapon control and visibility when sustaining fire.
perks_tango/ar_t9damage: Full-auto assault rifle.  High damage with a marginally slower fire rate.  Excellent stopping power for mid range encounters.
perks_tango/ar_t9fastfire: Full-auto assault rifle.  Fast fire rate with quick reloading speeds.  Modest damage and slightly less ammo capacity.
perks_tango/ar_t9fasthandling: Full-auto assault rifle.  Excellent handling speeds with improved damage.  Fast fire rate and fair damage range.
perks_tango/ar_t9longburst: Burst fire tactical rifle.  Excellent burst fire accuracy when aiming down sights.  Good visibility while firing with a slightly pronounced delay between bursts.
perks_tango/ar_t9mobility: Full-auto assault rifle.  Superior mobility with improved handling speeds.  Erratic initial recoil with less accurate hipfire spread.
perks_tango/ar_t9slowhandling: Full-auto assault rifle. High fire rate and muzzle velocity provides reliable stopping power from long range. Slightly heavier recoil with slower handling speeds.
perks_tango/ar_t9standard: Full-auto assault rifle.  Reliable damage with improved fire rate.  Fair weapon control when sustaining fire.
perks_tango/knife_t9loadout: Lethal melee weapon.  Straight-edge blade that kills enemies with a single deadly strike.
perks_tango/la_t9freefire: Free-fire rocket launcher.  Increased blast radius with heavy damage to vehicles, equipment, and personnel.  Additional rockets provided.
perks_tango/la_t9launcher: Grenade launcher.  Fires a grenade projectile that explodes on impact.  High damage with a significant blast radius.
perks_tango/la_t9standard: Free-fire rocket launcher.  Lock-on capability vs. enemy vehicles.  Locked rockets travel faster to their targets and maneuver in flight.
perks_tango/lm_t9accurate: Full-auto light machine gun.  Improved fire rate with a large ammo capacity.  Good recoil control and visibility when sustaining fire.
perks_tango/lm_t9light: Full-auto light machine gun.  Reliable stopping power with superior handling and movement speeds.
perks_tango/lm_t9rpapa: Full-auto light machine gun.  Reliable handling and damage with reduced accuracy.
perks_tango/lm_t9slowfire: Full-auto light machine gun. Consistent ammo capacity with heavy-grain rounds provides premium stopping power and bullet economy. Slower fire rate and handling speeds.
perks_tango/me_t9ballisticknife: Spring-action knife launcher.  Developed in the late '70's by Soviet forces.  Can be used to silently fire retrievable blades or as a melee weapon.
perks_tango/me_t9etool: Military style tri-fold entrenching shovel.  Typically used to dig a defensive fighting position, but is equally as effective as an ancillary weapon in close quarters combat.
perks_tango/me_t9loadout: Lethal melee weapon.  Straight-edge blade that kills enemies with a single deadly strike.
perks_tango/me_t9machete: Manufactured from a durable steel blade tempered to maximum toughness to resist chipping and breaking.  Popular in many tropical countries as both a weapon and an agricultural tool.
perks_tango/me_t9sledgehammer: Its name is derived from the word "slægan," meaning "to strike violently."  Distributes a large amount of force over a small area.  Repurposed to demolish your enemies instead of dry wall.
perks_tango/me_t9wakizashi: Famously known as the companion sword to the Samurai's Katana.  Traditionally forged using a folded steel technique.  Light to wield, resilient to force, and durable to wear.
perks_tango/pi_t9burst: Burst fire pistol.  Fast cyclic rate of fire with a short delay between bursts.  Increased ammo capacity and slightly slower reloading speeds.
perks_tango/pi_t9revolver: Double action revolver.  High damage with increased penetration and faster bullet velocity.
perks_tango/pi_t9semiauto: Semi-auto pistol.  Good accuracy with a modest ammo capacity.  High damage in close range encounters.
perks_tango/sh_t9fullauto: Full-auto shotgun.  Fastest fire rate in class with a larger ammo pool.  Reduced damage with reliable weapon control.
perks_tango/sh_t9pump: Pump-action shotgun.  High damage with a possible 1-shot kill in close quarters.  Hand loaded with moderate rechamber speed.
perks_tango/sh_t9semiauto: Semi-auto shotgun.  Reliable damage and pellet spread.  Heavy recoil and low visibility when sustaining fire.
perks_tango/sm_t9accurate: Full-auto submachine gun. Well rounded with excellent damage range and good accuracy. Moderate damage with an impressive muzzle velocity and a high fire rate.
perks_tango/sm_t9burst: 3-round burst submachine gun.  High damage with moderate range.  Burst fire spread is less efficient at long range.
perks_tango/sm_t9capacity: Full-auto submachine gun.  Reliable damage with improved range.  Large ammo pool and less accurate hipfire spread.
perks_tango/sm_t9fastfire: Full-auto submachine gun.  Excellent fire rate with higher vertical recoil.  Improved handling speeds with reduced damage.
perks_tango/sm_t9handling: Full-auto submachine gun.  High damage with a slower fire rate and fair recoil.  Improved handling speeds with more accurate hipfire spread.
perks_tango/sm_t9heavy: Full-auto submachine gun.  Improved damage with reliable weapon control.  Utilizes 5.45mm ammo for superior bullet velocity.
perks_tango/sm_t9powerburst: Burst fire tactical rifle.  High damage with moderate recoil and slower movement speeds when firing.  Built in optic provides 1.5x magnification.
perks_tango/sm_t9standard: Full-auto submachine gun.  Fast fire rate with low recoil. Good visibility and control while firing.
perks_tango/sn_t9cannon:
Bolt-action sniper rifle.  High damage, 1-shot kill to the head, chest, and shoulders.
Hold [{ONFOOT:+breath_sprint;+holdbreath}] while ADS to steady.
perks_tango/sn_t9damagesemi: Semi-auto tactical rifle.  High damage and reliable accuracy with lower ammo capacity.  Fair visibility and control while firing.
perks_tango/sn_t9powersemi: Semi-auto sniper rifle.  Heavy recoil with slow handling.  1-shot kill to the head or upper chest.  Hold [{ONFOOT:+breath_sprint;+holdbreath}] while ADS to steady.
perks_tango/sn_t9precisionsemi: Semi-auto tactical rifle.  Increased fire rate with minimal recoil.  Maintains reliable damage over longer range encounters.
perks_tango/sn_t9quickscope: Bolt-action sniper rifle.  Hand loaded with improved aim speeds and faster rechamber.  1-shot kill to the head or  upper chest.  Hold [{ONFOOT:+breath_sprint;+holdbreath}] while ADS to steady.
perks_tango/sn_t9standard: Bolt-action sniper rifle.  High damage with moderate sway.  1-shot kill to the head, chest, or shoulders.  Hold [{ONFOOT:+breath_sprint;+holdbreath}] while ADS to steady.
perks_wz335/br_serpentine_desc: Tactical Sprinting reduces incoming damage to base health from bullets by 15%.

platform/dyk_iw5_msg1: Field Orders have to be finished during your current life, and can't be completed by using Killstreaks.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg10: Change the Patches and Backgrounds you've earned in Character Customization.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg11: Scroll left and right on the Match Summary for more detailed info.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg12: Planting multiple SAT COMs at the same time increases your team's awareness of enemy movements.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg13: Leaving or shutting down mid-game will cause you to lose your Match Bonus.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg14: Earn Care Package airdrops by completing Field Orders. Care Packages award a random killstreak.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg15: In Infected mode, use Tactical Insertions as an Infected to mark where your next respawn will be.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg16: You can Neutralize an enemy controlled flag in Domination by reaching the halfway mark when capturing it.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg17: Complete Operations to earn bonus Patches, XP, Squad Points, and Character Customization gear.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg18: In Blitz, enter the enemy objective zone while it is active to score for your team.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg19: In Blitz, the enemy objective zone has a cool down period after each score; don't stay out in the open.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg2: Get Assault and Specialist Killstreak Rewards by getting consecutive kills without dying.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg20: The Muzzle Brake attachment increases your weapon's maximum effective range.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg21: The Off the Grid Perk makes you invisible to SAT COMs and radar pings.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg22: The Takedown Perk lets you kill enemies without revealing their death locations to their teammates.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg23: Bridge the gap between infantry and sniper with a Marksman Rifle.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg24: Contextual Lean can be disabled in the options menu if you prefer a more classic style of play.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg26: Holding crouch while sprinting initiates a tactical slide to help you get to cover.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg27: Fully charge a 9-Bang to create an EMP effect that temporarily disables Sentry Guns and other automated equipment.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg28: Want more control of your killstreak helicopter? Hop into the cockpit of an AAS-72X as a Helo Pilot.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg29: Use the Incog perk to stay hidden from enemy targeting, Thermal and Tracker sights, and Motion Sensors.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg3: Cranked is a fast-paced game mode where chaining kills gives you speed perks, 2x scoring, and keeps you alive.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg30: Some maps have special killstreak rewards when calling in Field Order Care Packages.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg31: In Search and Rescue, recover Dog Tags to respawn friendlies and deny enemy respawns.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg32: Check out the Squads playlists to see how your custom Squad stacks up against the competition.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg33: Assault and Marksman Rifle select fire types can be adjusted in the attachments menu.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg34: Provide tactical support from the sky with the Helo Scout killstreak.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg35: The Tracker Sight outlines enemy targets and can be flipped down on the fly for a wider field of view.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg36: The Honey Badger, VKS and K7 have integrated silencer attachments.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg37: The Night Owl drone follows you, detects enemies in close proximity and actively destroys incoming explosives.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg38: Killstreak Rewards attained from airdrop crates do not count towards your killstreak count.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg39: Akimbo weapons give you more firepower but restrict your ability to Aim Down Sight.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg4: Some killstreak rewards are controllable but leave you vulnerable on the ground.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg40: Combat Exclusion Rules lifted! Customize the look and gender of your Squad Member.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg41: Customize each Squad Member with its own Strike Package to be ready for any situation that might be thrown at you.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg42: Assault Strike Package items will chain kills to earn the next one.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg43: The Flash Suppressor attachment reduces muzzle flash for better accuracy, while maintaining full weapon damage.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg44: Armor Piercing rounds can penetrate Ballistic Vests, Juggernaut Armor and deal extra damage to killstreaks.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg45: The Wiretap Perk gives you access to active enemy SAT COMs on the field and stacks with your team's SAT COMs as well.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg46: Check out the Squads playlists to see how your custom Squad stacks up against the competition.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg47: The Specialist Strike Package lets you earn additional Perks as you kill, with a larger bonus at the end of your chain.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg48: Strike Packages give you the choice of supporting your team, being on the offensive, or being more of a lone gun.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg49: The Blind Eye Perk makes you undetectable by AI targeting systems of all kinds including air support and sentries.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg5: Track your Leaderboard position in the Barracks.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg50: The Vulture drone is a flying sentry gun that covers your six.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg51: The Trinity Rocket lets you control a missile from above that can fire off additional smart drone projectiles.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg52: The Support Strike Package doesn't reset your killstreak kills when you die.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg53: In a match, you have three killstreak slots with one extra slot to store any killstreaks you get by other means.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg54: Your extra killstreak slot stacks, so you don't need to worry about losing earned killstreaks when changing loadouts.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg55: Scroll up and down through your killstreaks and use the one that you want right now.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg6: One SAT COM activates 'Eyes On', marking enemies you see to the minimap. Place more SAT COMs to get a full radar sweep.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg7: Swap out Frag Grenades for Throwing Knives, Canister Bombs and other Lethal equipment.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg8: Your Guard Dog is your best friend. He alerts you to nearby enemies, protects you and avenges your death.
platform/dyk_iw5_msg9: Aiming Down Sights near the edge of an object, vehicle or building activates Contextual Lean.

seasonal_event/content_outbreak_desc_3: Verdansk is under siege by hordes of zombies, laying waste to everything in their path.
seasonal_event/cross_launch_prompt_zombi: Complete Challenges in Black Ops Cold War
seasonal_event/drop_into_caldera_desc: Krampus has come to Caldera to hunt the Naughty! Complete Event Challenges in both Warzone and Vanguard to unlock exclusive rewards and the festive ^*Epic Blueprint^7!
seasonal_event/drop_into_verdansk_desc: The Haunting has begun! Complete Event Challenges in both Warzone and Cold War to unlock exclusive rewards and the new Lapa SMG Weapon.
seasonal_event/event_desc_1: Now fully operational, a new ^$Factory^7 has begun production of the lethal Nebula V gas for use in various weapons. The development of these new weapons has been detected in underground ^$Bunkers^7 scattered around Caldera.
seasonal_event/event_desc_2: Fresh off the assembly line, a new fleet of ^$Bombers^7 have been delivered to Caldera. Just don't collide with the new ^$Redeploy Balloons^7 as these obstacles can severely damage your aircraft.
seasonal_event/event_desc_3: Distribution of the ^$Nebula V^7 gas is rolling out from ^$Armored Convoys^7. Ambush them to gain equipment and weapons. Deploy the new ^$Personal Decontamination Station^7 (P.D.S.) to briefly filter out toxic gas.
seasonal_event/event_onboarding_desc_0: Fight and secure the remnants of the crashed satellites.
seasonal_event/event_onboarding_desc_1: Stitch and Jackal have orchestrated the grounding of satellites across Verdansk and Cold War locales.
seasonal_event/event_onboarding_desc_2: In Cold War, fight over Uplink Stations in Fireteam Sat-Link. In Verdansk, secure Uplink Stations to locate lootable crash sites.
seasonal_event/event_onboarding_desc_3: Complete Challenges in Cold War and Warzone to unlock the exclusive Event Blueprint and other rewards.
seasonal_event/festivefervor_desc: Complete Festive Fervor challenges to unlock festive holiday loot. Complete all Vanguard or Warzone Challenges for a bonus reward.
seasonal_event/festivefervor_onboarding_: Seek. Shoot. Repeat. Elf Team Six has invaded and taken up positions throughout Vanguard and Warzone. Destroying them 3 times should scare them off for good!
Krampus hunts the naughty, the greedy, the coal-covered! Defeat Krampus to protect your team and earn valuable loot. In Vanguard, Krampus punishes those who don't play the objective.
Complete Festive Fervor challenges to unlock festive holiday loot. A final reward is given out for completing all of them.
seasonal_event/find_in_loot_crates: Find in loot crates around Verdansk
seasonal_event/h4a_onboarding_desc_1: Stitch is holding Adler at an undisclosed location in Verdansk. Gather Intel to pinpoint his position and rescue him.
seasonal_event/h4a_onboarding_desc_2: Complete Intel Challenges in Cold War and Warzone to unlock exclusive Event rewards.
seasonal_event/h4a_onboarding_desc_3: Complete either the Cold War or Warzone set of Challenges to unlock the exclusive Tortured and Rescued Adler Skin.
seasonal_event/halloween_description: Hunt down loot in select locations of Verdansk. Search through crates to find all of the special calling cards and unlock the exclusive Halloween blueprint. But, keep your wits about you! What you find may not always be a treat...
seasonal_event/halloween_onboarding_desc: Find crates throughout Verdansk that you can open.
There's a chance you will find calling cards, charms, emblems and more treats within the crates.
Find all of the event loot to earn an Exclusive Halloween Blueprint!
seasonal_event/haunt_onboarding_desc_1: In Warzone, drop into the limited-time Ghosts of Verdansk playlist and fend off the army of the dead. Manage your fear to avoid hallucinations. Die and return as a Ghost to haunt your enemies.
seasonal_event/haunt_onboarding_desc_2: In Cold War, trick-or-treat your way through Nuketown '84 Halloween and other Multiplayer and Zombies The Haunting Event playlists to unlock exclusive rewards.
seasonal_event/haunt_onboarding_desc_3: Unlock the all-new Lapa SMG by completing all 9 Cold War or Warzone The Haunting Event Challenges.
seasonal_event/launch_black_ops_mp_desc: The Haunting has begun! Complete Event Challenges in both Warzone and Cold War to unlock exclusive rewards and the new Lapa SMG Weapon.
seasonal_event/numbers_desc: The Broadcast is Live! Complete Event Challenges in Warzone and Cold War to unlock exclusive rewards and the new Dual Sai Melee Weapon.
seasonal_event/numbers_onboarding_desc_1: Interact with Mobile Broadcast Stations around Verdansk to hear the Numbers broadcast and complete location-based Challenges.
seasonal_event/numbers_onboarding_desc_2: In Cold War, earn rewards by completing The Numbers Event Challenges in either Multiplayer or Zombies.
seasonal_event/numbers_onboarding_desc_3: Unlock the all-new Dual Sai Melee Weapon by completing all 9 Cold War or Warzone Event Challenges.
seasonal_event/outbreak_onboarding_desc_: Fight off the Zombie horde in Warzone and Outbreak, the all-new Black Ops Cold War Zombies mode.
Complete Warzone and Outbreak Challenges to unlock exclusive Event rewards.
Complete each set of Warzone and Outbreak Challenges to unlock the 2 exclusive Event Blueprints.
