vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_arms_dealer_kam_2: ^2Kamarov:^7 This is an arms dealer they call, "Mr. Z." Z is wanted by the International Criminal Court for "conspiracy to transport, sell, and supply arms to a foreign terrorist organization."
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_arms_dealer_kam_5: ^2Kamarov:^7 A volunteer physician on the ground, Dr. Linda Morales, informed us that Z's been using medical shipments as a front for moving hazardous materials into Verdansk.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_arms_dealer_kam_6: ^2Kamarov:^7 Four hours ago, she was taken hostage by AQ operatives.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_arms_dealer_lass_1: ^2Laswell:^7 The criteria for mission success is to defeat Al-Qatala's supply chain.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_arms_dealer_lass_3: ^2Laswell:^7 Mr. Z appears to have focused on one exclusive client, Al-Qatala's new number one...
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_arms_dealer_lass_4: ^2Laswell:^7 ...and has positioned himself as both supplier and advisor to the terrorist leader.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_arms_dealer_lass_7: ^2Laswell:^7 Armistice's primary objective is to rescue Dr. Morales. If Z is bringing chemical weapons into this fight, she may know where to find them.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_banker_kam_2: ^2Kamarov:^7 For that, Al-Qatala uses a British banker, one of our primary HVTs and the man responsible for laundering their currency.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_banker_kam_4: ^2Kamarov:^7 We need an assault force on the ground to shut these transactions down. Your team will target hostile forces for intel that points us to the Banker's crypto servers.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_banker_lass_1: ^2Laswell:^7 The war in Verdansk runs on a black market. That means dirty money and someone to clean it.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_banker_lass_3: ^2Laswell:^7 We don't know the Banker's name, but we do know he runs a system of server farms that spit-shine AQ cash so they can weaponize the proceeds.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_banker_lass_5: ^2Laswell:^7 Once you retrieve enough data, we'll triangulate it, freeze their assets, and attempt to revoke the birth certificate of the man who holds the purse strings.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_banker_lass_6: ^2Laswell:^7 First and foremost, get in country, and round up AQ fighters for actionable intel on the Banker's operation.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_kam_2: ^2Kamarov:^7 We've put our differences aside. Together, as Armistice, this is our first direct action against the Al-Qatala army.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_kam_4: ^2Kamarov:^7 These HVTs are powerful, well-connected collaborators, offering material aid and support to our enemy.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_kam_6: ^2Kamarov:^7 Your first operation is against a high-ranking AQ figure they call "Almalik", the Landlord.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_kam_8: ^2Kamarov:^7 Your team will insert into the southern district to engage and capture enemy personnel for intel leading to Almalik's warehouses.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_lass_1: ^2Laswell:^7 This is Case Officer Laswell of the Coalition. I'm in joint command with Sergeant Kamarov of the Allegiance.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_lass_10: ^2Laswell:^7 Be advised, if you find him, he will be well defended.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_lass_3: ^2Laswell:^7 Your mission is to find, fix, and finish off high-value targets of the AQ network in Verdansk.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_lass_5: ^2Laswell:^7 They all serve one new master, who's leading the Al-Qatala charge in Verdansk. To find him, we need to find them.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_lass_7: ^2Laswell:^7 Almalik owns several warehouses across Verdansk, serving as Al-Qatala weapons depots. He's a slumlord for guns and terrorists.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_landlord_lass_9: ^2Laswell:^7 Get this right and we will nullify AQ's stockpiles. Hit the jackpot and we locate Almalik himself.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_outro_kam_4: ^2Kamarov:^7 Thanks to your assault teams, the Al-Qatala support network has been cut off and the power brokers that emboldened this terrorist threat have been eliminated.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_outro_kam_8: ^2Kamarov:^7 This unknown leader is now calling his army, "Al-Qatala-Aljahdid", the 'New' Killers.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_outro_lass_1: ^2Laswell:^7 From the onset of this operation, the formation of Armistice ruffled feathers.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_outro_lass_2: ^2Laswell:^7 They said Russian and the West couldn't work together...
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_outro_lass_5: ^2Laswell:^7 However, Mr. Z still remains at large.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_outro_lass_6: ^2Laswell:^7 His weapons are locked and loaded in terrorist hands all over Verdansk.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_outro_lass_7: ^2Laswell:^7 Our presence in the region is the only line of defense preventing Z and the new AQ boss from pushing through to Urzikstan.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_outro_lass_9: ^2Laswell:^7 These New Killers are calling him, "The Immortal Lion", or "Khaled Al-Asad".
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_smuggler_kam_3: ^2Kamarov:^7 This is 'El Traficante'. He helms a worldwide smuggling operation based in South America that moves contraband all over the globe.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_smuggler_kam_5: ^2Kamarov:^7 A local asset reported that El Traficante is moving something big across Verdansk before sundown.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_smuggler_kam_6: ^2Kamarov:^7 At 0700, he transmitted a distress signal. That was our last contact.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_smuggler_kam_8: ^2Kamarov:^7 Infil your team to the north zone, where you'll assault a series of AQ safehouses. Search and send back any intel you find.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_smuggler_lass_1: ^2Laswell:^7 Our gains in Verdansk could kick the hornet's nest.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_smuggler_lass_2: ^2Laswell:^7 As Armistice eliminates their upper echelon, Al-Qatala is making more aggressive and desperate moves.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_smuggler_lass_4: ^2Laswell:^7 He protects himself, his customers, and his shipments. We're going after all three.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_smuggler_lass_7: ^2Laswell:^7 You need to reacquire the asset and learn what he knows about El Traficante's plan so we can stop it.
vidsubtitles/cp_mbi_smuggler_lass_9: ^2Laswell:^7 Time is not on our side. If El Traficante is coordinating a move, AQ may be launching a strike tonight.
vidsubtitles/cp_opening_cine_intro_kam_3: ^2Kamarov:^7 These new weapons...give Al-Qatala the power to turn acts of terror into acts of war.
^2Kamarov:^7 This is a problem. For everyone.
vidsubtitles/cp_opening_cine_intro_lass_: ^2Laswell:^7 The city's under evacuation. Al-Qatala's got complete control.
^2Laswell:^7 We don't know, but he's got friends in high places.
^2Laswell:^7 Sergeant Kamarov is going to help conduct this operation.
^2Laswell:^7 We're launching a multi-lateral force to hunt AQ's new leader and contain this threat while we still can.
vidsubtitles/cp_opening_cine_intro_nik_1: ^2Nikolai:^7 East and West rebuilt Verdansk after the Cold War.
vidsubtitles/cp_opening_cine_intro_nik_2: ^2Nikolai:^7 The CIA working with the FSB?
vidsubtitles/cp_opening_cine_intro_pri_4: ^2Price:^7 Start up your teams. Let's operate.
vidsubtitles/cp_opening_cine_intro_rus_2: ^1Russian Soldier:^7 We have tanks and armor approaching from the east!
vidsubtitles/cp_opening_cine_intro_rus_3: ^1Russian Soldier:^7 Taking heavy casualties! Do you copy?
vidsubtitles/cp_opening_cine_intro_rus_7: ^1Russian Soldier:^7 All stations this net: we're overrun!
vidsubtitles/cp_season_01_stinger_01: Stand by for your next deployment against the AQ army...
vidsubtitles/dx_brm_ac130_cine_intro_pri: ^2Price:^7 Verdansk was ground zero in the Cold War.
^2Price:^7 It's a bloody powder keg, and Zakhaev already lit the fuse...
^2Price:^7 A city of tunnels, gulags, bunkers, and weapons of mass destruction.
^2Price:^7 His father was a Soviet Era hero who wanted a world war he never got, so Victor found a willing partner to fulfill his father's wishes.
^2Price:^7 Al-Asad had an axe to grind against the Superpowers.
^2Price:^7 He was freed... armed... and turned loose...
^2Price:^7 Coalition and Allegiance forces signed treaties and sent in their best to restore order, but Zakhaev pulled strings, sowed distrust and divided.
^2Price:^7 We turned our guns back on each other, just like he wanted.
^2Price:^7 Intel says there's still a hidden world here... And plans to use it.

The common enemy of human civilization.

You will play different roles in this story to participate in Counter-terrorism campaign.

zmui/bgb_aftertaste_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 5 minutes or 1 down)
Keep all Loadout Perks after being revived.  Non-Loadout Perks are still lost when downed.
zmui/bgb_alchemical_antithesis_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 1 minute)
Every 10 points earned is instead awarded 1 ammo in the stock of the current weapon.
zmui/bgb_always_done_swiftly_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 5 minutes)
Walk faster while aiming. Raise and lower your weapon to aim more quickly.
zmui/bgb_anti_entrapment_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 30 seconds)
Immune to player initiated trap damage.
zmui/bgb_anywhere_but_here_desc:
Instant Activation
Instantly teleport to a random location. A concussive blast knocks away any nearby zombies, keeping you safe.
zmui/bgb_arsenal_accelerator_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 2 minutes)
Charge your special weapon faster.
zmui/bgb_blood_debt_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 1 minute)
Instead of losing health, you lose points. Amount lost increases each time you are hit until max amount is hit. If you have 0 points, Blood Debt ends.
zmui/bgb_bullet_boost_desc:
Instant Activation
Applies or re-rolls an AAT to your current weapon (if supported).  Weapon Damage is not affected.
zmui/bgb_burned_out_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts three hits)
The next time you take melee damage, nearby zombies burst into fire.
zmui/bgb_cache_back_desc:
Instant Activation
Spawns a Max Ammo power up.
zmui/bgb_ctrl_z_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 30 seconds)
Turns zombies near you into allies (Max 2).
zmui/bgb_dead_of_nuclear_winter_desc:
Instant Activation
Spawns a Nuke power up.
zmui/bgb_equip_mint_desc:
Instant Activation
Refreshes cooldown on your equipment.
zmui/bgb_extra_credit_desc:
Instant Activation
Spawns a personal 1250 point power up.
zmui/bgb_free_fire_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 30 seconds)
Fire weapons without using up bullets.
zmui/bgb_head_drama_desc:
Activates Immediately (Lasts 5 minutes)
Any bullet which hits a zombie will damage its head.
zmui/bgb_head_scan_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 2 minutes)
Headshots have a chance to Instakill.
zmui/bgb_immolation_liquidation_desc:
Instant Activation
Spawns a Fire Sale power up.
zmui/bgb_in_plain_sight_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 10 seconds)
You are ignored by zombies.
zmui/bgb_join_the_party_desc:
Instant Activation
All players in spectate will spawn in immediately and all downed players will be immediately revived.  Will not restore lost Perks.
zmui/bgb_kill_joy_desc:
Instant Activation
Spawns an Instakill power up.
zmui/bgb_licensed_contractor_desc:
Instant Activation
Spawns a Carpenter power up.
zmui/bgb_near_death_experience_desc:
Activates Immediately (Lasts 10 minutes or 5 revives)
Revive, or be revived, simply by being near other players. Revived players keep all Loadout Perks after being revived.
zmui/bgb_newtonian_negation_desc:
^6W^3H^5I^2M^7S^2I^5C^3A^6L
^7Instant Activation (Lasts 25 minutes)
Zombies killed fall straight up.
zmui/bgb_now_you_see_me_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 15 seconds)
All zombies will chase you.
zmui/bgb_nowhere_but_there_desc:
Instant Activation
Teleport to a downed player's location.
zmui/bgb_perkaholic_desc:
Activates Immediately
Receive all Loadout Perks and six random, extra Perks that are not in your loadout. Will not stack with itself.
zmui/bgb_phantom_reload_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 4 minutes)
Reloading has a 30% chance to fill the magazine without using up stock ammo.
zmui/bgb_phoenix_up_desc:
Instant Activation
Revives all teammates. Teammates keep all Loadout Perks after being revived.
zmui/bgb_point_drops_desc:
Instant Activation
Drop 500 of your points as a power up.
zmui/bgb_pop_shocks_desc:
Auto-activates when melee attacking zombies (5 Melees)
Melee attacks trigger an electrostatic discharge, electrocuting nearby zombies.
zmui/bgb_power_keg_desc:
Instant Activation
Spawns a Full Power power up.
zmui/bgb_power_vacuum_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 5 minutes)
More power ups can drop each round.
zmui/bgb_reign_drops_desc:
Instant Activation
Spawns one of each of the nine core power ups.
zmui/bgb_secret_shopper_desc:
Activates Immediately (Lasts 10 minutes)
Any gun wall-buy can be used to buy ammo for any gun.
zmui/bgb_shields_up_desc:
Instant Activation
Gives a new shield.
zmui/bgb_shopping_free_desc:
Activates Immediately (Lasts 1 minute)
All purchases are free.
zmui/bgb_stock_option_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 2 minutes)
Ammo is taken from your stockpile instead of your weapon's magazine.
zmui/bgb_suit_up_desc:
Instant Activation
You and nearby players get full Armor which lasts until destroyed.
zmui/bgb_sword_flay_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 1 minute)
Melee attacks instantly kill basic and vermin enemies, otherwise they deal 5x as much damage.
zmui/bgb_temporal_gift_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 5 minutes)
Power ups last longer.
zmui/bgb_undead_man_walking_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 1 minute)
Slow down all zombies to shambling speed.
zmui/bgb_wall_power_desc:
Auto-activates on your next wall-buy gun purchase
The next gun bought off a wall comes Pack-a-Punched.
zmui/bgb_wall_to_wall_clearance_desc:
Instant Activation (Lasts 30 seconds)
Wall buy Fire Sale.
zmui/bgb_whos_keeping_score_desc:
Instant Activation
Spawns a Double Points power up.
zmui/cov_aether_grenades_desc: Small chance to keep equipment after using it
zmui/cov_ammo_gremlin_desc: Stowed weapons refill ammo from stock slowly
zmui/cov_bloodlust_desc: Melee attacks do more damage and heal you
zmui/cov_brain_rot_desc: Chance to Turn a normal enemy when shooting it
zmui/cov_cryofreeze_desc: Chance to slow a normal enemy when shooting it
zmui/cov_cull_the_weak_desc: Deal more damage to slowed or stunned enemies
zmui/cov_dead_accurate_desc: Successive shots on the same enemy deal more damage
zmui/cov_splatterfest_desc: Enemies killed by explosions have a chance to explode
zmui/cov_unholy_ground_desc: Deal more damage when shooting while stationary
zmui/selfrevive_desc: Use when downed to revive yourself.
zmweapon/hero_chakram_desc: Paired chakrams, one for throwing and another for melee.
zmweapon/hero_flamethrower_s1_desc: Assembled with Russian know-how from the scraps of war and inter-dimensional combat, the Hellfire flamethrower has incinerated legions of filthy hell-pigs.
zmweapon/hero_gravityspikes_s1_desc: Inspired by designs of the DG-4 and perfected in Richtofen's Lab, the Ragnarok DG-5 converts trace quantities of Element 115 into reckless amounts of electricity.
zmweapon/hero_hammer_desc: A hammer for wading directly into battle.
zmweapon/hero_katana_s1_desc: Carried by Takeo Masaki through both victory and sacrifice, the Path of Sorrows is a tragic blade with many more tales to tell.
zmweapon/hero_minigun_s1_desc: Adopted by Dempsey with love and affection from a Group 935 armory, the Overkill mini-gun can chop meat and cut daisies with the greatest of ease.
zmweapon/hero_scepter_desc: A staff with ranged healing and slowing capability.
zmweapon/hero_sword_pistol_desc: A paired whip sword and hand cannon for mid-range flexibility.
zombie/cymbal_monkey_wz_desc: When thrown, becomes a retrievable bomb that will make noise and detonate when an enemy or zombie approaches.
zombie/desc_ammo_brain_rot: Bullets deal toxic damage. Each bullet has a chance to turn an enemy to an ally.
zombie/desc_ammo_cyro_freeze: Bullets deal frost damage. Each bullet has a chance to slow enemies.
zombie/desc_ammo_dead_wire: Bullets deal electric damage. Each bullet has a chance to stun enemies.
zombie/desc_ammo_napalm_burst: Bullets deal fire damage. Each bullet has a chance to ignite enemies.
zombie/perk_desc_deadshot_daiquiri: Drink to improve aiming down sights.
zombie/perk_desc_quick_revive: Drink to recover health and revive faster.
zombie/perk_desc_staminup: Drink to run and sprint faster.
